scope: Published page headings, summaries and directory cards; search page itself excluded. No remote search or model calls. Rebuild after site builds.

entries.summaryZh: 纠错与来源补充
entries.summaryEn: Corrections and source additions

entries.zh: 从一个概念，或一件想完成的事开始
entries.en: Start with a concept or a task you want to finish.
entries.summaryZh: 6 个站 ，各管一件事。卡在哪儿就翻哪儿，不卡的地方跳过也完全没问题。
entries.summaryEn: Six sites , one job each. Look up whatever you are stuck on; skip the rest, that is fine.

entries.summaryZh: 除非另有注明，下列内容由 Specul 自行创作并保留所有权利：本站未对文案与设计单独授予复制、改编、再分发或商业使用许可。欢迎正常链接与引用，引用单句请注明「specul.com」并附本页链接；需要整篇转载或商业使用，请先联系本站。例外：tools.specul.com 的档案文字与数据按 tools 内容仓的 LICENSE 以 CC BY 4.0 发布。
entries.summaryEn: Unless noted otherwise, the following is created by Specul and all rights are reserved: no separate licence is granted for copying, adapting, redistributing or commercial use of the copy and design. Normal links and quotation are welcome — quote a sentence with credit to “specul.com” and a link back to this page; for f

entries.summaryZh: 中文名、英文名与常见别名集中在一页；点名字进词条。
entries.summaryEn: Chinese names, English names and common aliases on one page; click a name to open the term.

entries.summaryZh: 刚接触 AI，先弄清「谁是谁、谁先谁后」。这一页有三栏：关键模型时间线、公司版图、术语演变。每条都带官方出处。
entries.summaryEn: Getting into AI starts with who's who and what came first. Three columns here: a timeline of key models, a company map, and how the vocabulary changed. Every entry carries an official source.

entries.summaryZh: 只列官方发布与停运日期，不做新闻、不做预测。用来回答「这个产品现在还是不是这样」：每条都带官方出处与核验日。
entries.summaryEn: Official update snapshots: distinguish dates, rollout scope and planned shutdowns, with source references.

entries.summaryZh: 榜单不是真理，但不同基准测的是不同能力。这张地图按编码、Agent、长文、多模态、安全分组，并给出读榜检查项。
entries.summaryEn: Leaderboards are not truth, but different benchmarks measure different abilities. This map groups coding, agents, long context, multimodal and safety, with a reading checklist.

entries.summaryZh: Agent 的成败不只在最终答案：工具选对没、参数对不对、走了多少步、花了多少钱，都要进评测。
entries.summaryEn: Agent success is not only the final answer: whether tools were chosen correctly, arguments were right, how many steps it took and what it cost all belong in the eval.

entries.summaryZh: AI 的错误有固定套路。认出这几类，就能提前防住大半。
entries.summaryEn: AI mistakes follow fixed patterns. Recognizing these categories prevents most of them in advance.

entries.summaryZh: 把「参数越多越聪明」「上下文越大越好」「榜单高就好用」这些误区串成一张索引，每条指向对应的解释。
entries.summaryEn: An index of misconceptions — more parameters is smarter, bigger context is better, a high leaderboard score means usable — each pointing to its explanation.
entries.aliases: guide AI 常见误区总索引

entries.zh: AI 真的读懂了你的话吗
entries.summaryZh: 回答贴切不等于理解——它在做的是另一件事。
entries.summaryEn: A fitting answer is not understanding — it is doing something else.
entries.aliases: guide AI 真的读懂了你的话吗

entries.summaryZh: 在提示里放几个「输入→输出」例子能明显改变表现，但例子选得不好反而带偏。这篇讲选例子的五条标准。
entries.summaryEn: Dropping a few input→output examples into the prompt changes performance noticeably — but bad examples steer the model the wrong way. Five criteria for picking them.

entries.zh: RAG 全链路：从文档到答案
entries.en: RAG End to End: From Documents to Answers
entries.summaryZh: 分块、嵌入、检索、重排、生成、引用——RAG 的每一步都会单独失败；这篇把它们串成一条可排障的链路。
entries.summaryEn: Parsing, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, generation and citation — every step fails on its own. This guide strings them into a debuggable pipeline.
entries.aliases: guide RAG 全链路：从文档到答案

entries.summaryZh: 上下文工程不是「多塞资料」，而是决定每一轮该让模型看到什么、看不到什么，以及怎么压缩。
entries.summaryEn: Context engineering is not "stuff more material in". It decides what the model sees each turn, what it does not see, and how to compress the rest.
entries.aliases: guide 上下文工程怎么做

entries.summaryZh: 窗口大小有代价，够用比拉满更划算。
entries.summaryEn: Window size has a price; enough beats maximum.
entries.aliases: guide 上下文窗口越大越好

entries.summaryZh: RAG 不是默认选项。它适合「知识会变、要出处」的场景，不适合另一些场景，硬上反而更差。
entries.summaryEn: RAG is not the default. It fits "knowledge changes, citations required"; it hurts other scenarios, and forcing it makes things worse.
entries.aliases: guide 什么时候不该用 RAG

entries.summaryZh: 护栏改变的是默认路径，不是所有路径。
entries.summaryEn: Guardrails change the default path, not every path.
entries.aliases: guide 加了护栏就安全了

entries.summaryZh: 参数量只是其中一个变量，不是聪明程度的刻度。
entries.summaryEn: Parameter count is one variable, not a dial for intelligence.
entries.aliases: guide 参数越多就越聪明

entries.summaryZh: 写出来的步骤，不保证是产生答案的实际路径。
entries.summaryEn: The steps it writes are not guaranteed to be the path that produced the answer.

entries.summaryZh: 拒答多半是训练出来的选择，不是能力上限。
entries.summaryEn: Most refusals are a trained choice, not a capability ceiling.
entries.aliases: guide 它拒绝，是因为做不到

entries.en: It Remembers What You Said Earlier
entries.summaryZh: 它能看到的范围叫上下文窗口，超出部分不在输入里。
entries.summaryEn: What it can see is the context window; anything outside is not in its input.
entries.aliases: guide 它记得你之前说过的

entries.summaryZh: 流畅与正确是两件事，笃定的语气不增加可靠性。
entries.summaryEn: Fluency and correctness are separate; a confident tone adds no reliability.
entries.aliases: guide 它说得笃定，所以可信

entries.en: It Reads Your Words One By One
entries.summaryZh: 它看到的不是字，是词表里的编号。
entries.summaryEn: What it sees is not characters but ids from a vocabulary.
entries.aliases: guide 它逐字读懂你的文字

entries.summaryZh: 开源保证的是使用权与可改性，不是免费。
entries.summaryEn: Open guarantees the right to use and modify, not that it is free.
entries.aliases: guide 开源模型一定更省钱

entries.zh: 怎么估算一次上线的安全成本
entries.en: How to Estimate the Safety Cost of a Launch
entries.summaryZh: 把「安全成本」拆成人时、算力、复核、返工四块，每块都用你自己查得到的数字或标明假设来估。
entries.summaryEn: Split "safety cost" into labour, compute, review and rework, and estimate each with numbers you can look up - or with assumptions labelled as assumptions.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么估算一次上线的安全成本

entries.summaryZh: 把资料交给 AI 之前，先想清楚它会去哪里、会留下什么。这份指南讲六个动作。
entries.summaryEn: Before handing material to an AI, be clear about where it goes and what it leaves behind. Six moves.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么保护自己的数据

entries.summaryZh: 向量检索擅长意思相近，关键词检索擅长精确匹配。混合检索把两条路的结果合起来。
entries.summaryEn: Vector search is good at similar meaning; keyword search is good at exact matches. Hybrid search merges the results of both paths.

entries.zh: 怎么写一份能被复核的任务指令
entries.en: How to Write a Task Brief Someone Can Review
entries.summaryZh: 把「帮我弄一下」写成别人能照着核对的指令：目标、输入、边界、验收口径四样都落到字面上。
entries.summaryEn: Turn "help me with this" into an instruction others can check: spell out the goal, the inputs, the boundaries, and what counts as passing.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么写一份能被复核的任务指令

entries.zh: 怎么判断 AI 新闻是不是炒作
entries.en: How to Tell if AI News Is Hype
entries.summaryZh: AI 新闻可能省略测试条件或放大适用范围。先核对原始出处、评测设置和未验证的部分，再判断结论。
entries.summaryEn: AI news can omit test conditions or overstate scope. Check the original source, evaluation setup and unresolved claims before accepting a conclusion.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么判断 AI 新闻是不是炒作

entries.summaryZh: 同样问 AI，问法不同，答案的可用性差很多。这份指南讲提问前要交代的五件事。
entries.summaryEn: The same question asked differently produces very different answers. This guide covers the five things to state before you ask.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么向 AI 提问

entries.zh: 怎么处理一次误发事故
entries.en: How to Handle a Misfire Incident
entries.summaryZh: AI 内容误发（错答进了客户邮件、错代码合进了主干）按事件处理：先止血、再定范围、再复盘，先不追人。
entries.summaryEn: Treat a misfire (a wrong answer in a customer email, wrong code merged to main) as an incident: stop the bleeding, scope it, then review - do not start with blame.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么处理一次误发事故

entries.zh: 怎么安全地用 MCP 工具
entries.en: How to Use MCP Tools Safely
entries.summaryZh: MCP 让 AI 能碰你的文件和网页。工具本身不危险，危险的是它被喂了什么内容、被给了什么权限。
entries.summaryEn: MCP lets an AI touch your files and the web. The tools themselves are not the danger; what gets fed to them and what permissions they hold is.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么安全地用 MCP 工具

entries.zh: 怎么审一次第三方插件
entries.en: How to Audit a Third-Party Plugin
entries.summaryZh: 接一个第三方 MCP server 或插件之前，审四件事：它要什么权限、代码从哪来、数据往哪去、出事谁负责。
entries.summaryEn: Before connecting a third-party MCP server or plugin, audit four things: what permissions it asks for, where its code comes from, where data goes, and who owns an incident.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么审一次第三方插件

entries.zh: 怎么对照 EU AI Act 自查
entries.en: How to Self-Check Against the EU AI Act
entries.summaryZh: 欧盟 AI 法按风险分四档，义务按时间分批生效。这份指南讲怎么先给自己定性，再看撞上哪一档。
entries.summaryEn: The EU AI Act sorts AI into four risk tiers, with obligations taking effect in batches. This guide covers how to classify yourself and which tier you hit.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么对照 EU AI Act 自查

entries.zh: 怎么把安全要求写进采购条款
entries.en: How to Write Safety Requirements into a Procurement Contract
entries.summaryZh: 采购条款的作用，是把你在意的事写成对方必须交付的东西：文档、通知、日志、退出四个交付点。
entries.summaryEn: Procurement clauses turn what you care about into what the supplier must deliver: documents, notices, logs and exit - four levers.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么把安全要求写进采购条款

entries.summaryZh: 「怎么向 AI 提问」讲问前交代什么；这篇讲把这些交代放进什么形状：角色、任务、约束、格式，四块分开写。
entries.summaryEn: "How to Ask AI" covers what to state before asking; this guide covers what shape to put it in: role, task, constraints, and format, written as separate blocks.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么把提示词写结构

entries.en: How to Choose an Embedding Model
entries.summaryZh: embedding 模型决定「意思相近」怎么算。挑错模型，后面检索、重排、回答全跟着吃亏。
entries.summaryEn: The embedding model decides how "similar in meaning" is computed. Pick it wrong and retrieval, reranking, and answering all suffer.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么挑 embedding 模型

entries.zh: 怎么排查 AI 的数据泄露路径
entries.en: How to Trace AI Data Leak Paths
entries.summaryZh: 数据离开你，通常不止一条路。这份指南把常见泄露路径逐条列出来，一条条查自己踩了哪几条。
entries.summaryEn: Data usually leaves you through more than one path. This guide lists the common leak paths one by one so you can check which ones you are on.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么排查 AI 的数据泄露路径

entries.zh: 怎么搭一条最小评测流程
entries.en: How to Set Up a Minimal Evaluation Pipeline
entries.summaryZh: 不必攒几十项基准。一条能用的评测流水线只要五件东西：样本、口径、判法、记录、复跑。
entries.summaryEn: You do not need dozens of benchmarks. A usable evaluation pipeline needs five things: samples, criteria, judgment method, records, reruns.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么搭一条最小评测流程

entries.zh: 怎么查 AI 生成内容的版权风险
entries.en: How to Check Copyright Risk for AI-Generated Content
entries.summaryZh: AI 内容的版权有两头。喂进去的数据合不合法，生成出来的东西归不归你。这份指南讲两头各怎么查。
entries.summaryEn: AI content copyright has two ends: whether the data fed in is lawful, and whether what comes out belongs to you. This guide checks both ends.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么查 AI 生成内容的版权风险

entries.zh: 怎么查生成式 AI 合规义务
entries.en: How to Check Generative AI Compliance Duties
entries.summaryZh: 在国内上线一个 AI 功能，合规不是玄学，是几条能核对的条文。这份指南按上线顺序讲先查什么。
entries.summaryEn: Launching an AI feature in China, compliance is not mysticism but a handful of checkable articles. This guide walks them in launch order.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么查生成式 AI 合规义务

entries.zh: 怎么给 AI 内容做发布前检查
entries.en: How to Run a Pre-Publication Check on AI Content
entries.summaryZh: AI 生成的内容发出去之前，有几类错误几乎必然出现。这份指南给一份发布前的检查清单。
entries.summaryEn: Before publishing AI-generated content, a few classes of error appear almost inevitably. This guide is the pre-publication checklist.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么给 AI 内容做发布前检查

entries.zh: 怎么给 AI 内容加来源标识
entries.summaryZh: 来源标识分三层：看得见的提示、文件里的凭证、生成侧的水印。这篇讲三层各自加在哪、会丢在哪。
entries.summaryEn: Provenance has three layers: the visible notice, the credentials inside the file, and the generator-side watermark. Here is where each is added and where each gets lost.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么给 AI 内容加来源标识

entries.zh: 怎么给 AI 工具配权限
entries.en: How to Set Permissions for AI Tools
entries.summaryZh: AI 工具的危险程度，多半由你给它的权限决定。这份指南讲怎么给得刚好够用、又不过头。
entries.summaryEn: How dangerous an AI tool is is mostly decided by the permissions you give it. This guide covers granting exactly enough and no more.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么给 AI 工具配权限

entries.zh: 怎么给团队做 AI 风险清单
entries.en: How to Build an AI Risk List for Your Team
entries.summaryZh: 风险清单不是把「安全」写成口号，而是按场景列清：可能出什么事、现在挡了什么、谁负责补剩下的。
entries.summaryEn: A risk list is not "safety" written as a slogan; per use case it states what could go wrong, what already blocks it, and who closes the rest.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么给团队做 AI 风险清单

entries.en: How to Chunk Documents for Retrieval
entries.summaryZh: 检索增强第一步是把文档切成块。块切得好不好，直接决定后面找不找得到答案。
entries.summaryEn: The first step of retrieval-augmented generation is cutting documents into chunks. How well you cut decides whether answers can be found at all.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么给文档做分块

entries.summaryZh: 检索先取回候选，重排再调整顺序。它能否改善最终结果，要看候选是否包含答案、排序质量和延迟预算。
entries.summaryEn: Retrieval returns candidates; reranking changes their order. Benefits depend on answer coverage, ranking quality and latency budget.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么给检索结果重排

entries.en: How to Build Your Own Eval
entries.summaryZh: 公共榜单测不出「它在我这活儿上行不行」。这篇讲怎么搭一套只属于你的评测：题目、判分、跑法。
entries.summaryEn: Public leaderboards can't answer "is it good at my job". How to build an eval that is yours alone: questions, grading, and how to run it.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么自建评测口径

entries.zh: 怎么让 AI 按格式输出
entries.en: How to Get AI to Output in Your Format
entries.summaryZh: 程序要接 AI 的输出时，「请输出 JSON」经常不够。这篇讲从提示约束到结构化输出的三级做法。
entries.summaryEn: When a program has to consume AI output, "please output JSON" often isn't enough. Three levels, from prompt-level constraints to structured outputs.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么让AI按格式输出

entries.zh: 怎么设计人工复核环节
entries.en: How to Design a Human Review Step
entries.summaryZh: 人工复核不是「加个人点确认」，而是让人看得出错、有权拦下、责任能落到人的一个环节。
entries.summaryEn: Human review is not "add a person who clicks confirm"; it is a step where someone can see the error, can block it, and carries a named responsibility.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么设计人工复核环节

entries.zh: 怎么评测 RAG 的效果
entries.en: How to Evaluate a RAG System
entries.summaryZh: RAG 出问题可能出在检索，也可能出在生成。评测要分开量，不然修错地方。
entries.summaryEn: A RAG failure can come from retrieval or from generation. Evaluate them separately, or you will fix the wrong part.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么评测 RAG 的效果

entries.en: How to Read an AI Paper
entries.summaryZh: 读不动论文，多半不是英语问题，是顺序问题。这份指南讲拿到一篇 AI 论文后按什么顺序读、每步要回答什么问题。
entries.summaryEn: Not being able to get through a paper is usually a sequencing problem, not an English problem. This guide is the order to read an AI paper in, and the question each step should answer.

entries.zh: 怎么读开源模型的许可证
entries.en: How to Read an Open-Model License
entries.summaryZh: 「开源」不等于随便用。模型许可证里的条件，决定你能不能商用、要不要署名、衍生模型跟不跟同许可。
entries.summaryEn: "Open source" does not mean use however you like. The conditions in a model license decide whether you may use it commercially, attribute, and what derivatives inherit.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么读开源模型的许可证

entries.en: How to Read a Model Card
entries.summaryZh: 模型卡是厂商给模型的说明书。这份指南讲读它时该看哪几栏、哪些话要打折。
entries.summaryEn: A model card is the manufacturer's spec sheet for a model. This guide covers which sections to read and which claims to discount.

entries.zh: 怎么读模型卡与系统卡
entries.en: How to Read Model Cards and System Cards
entries.summaryZh: 模型卡讲「这个模型是什么、怎么用」，系统卡与部署安全页讲「上线前测过什么、还担心什么」。两份要分开读、对照读。
entries.summaryEn: Model cards say what a model is and how to use it; system cards and deployment safety pages say what was tested before release and what still worries the publisher. Read them separately, and side by side.
entries.aliases: guide 怎么读模型卡与系统卡

entries.en: How to Guard Against Prompt Injection
entries.summaryZh: 提示注入是让外部内容劫持 AI 的攻击。这份指南讲怎么给 AI 工具设防线，让它不把网页里的话当命令。
entries.summaryEn: Prompt injection is an attack where outside content hijacks an AI. This guide covers how to build defenses so your AI tool treats web pages as data, not commands.

entries.zh: 怎么验证 AI 的输出
entries.summaryZh: AI 会一本正经地编造事实。这份指南讲怎么把「它说的」变成「你能核对的」。
entries.summaryEn: AI will state fabricated facts with full confidence. This guide turns "what it said" into "what you can check".
entries.aliases: guide 怎么验证 AI 的输出

entries.summaryZh: 「一步步想」对某些任务提升明显，对另一些几乎没用甚至帮倒忙。这篇讲怎么判断值不值得让模型展开推理。
entries.summaryEn: "Think step by step" helps some tasks a lot and barely helps — or actively hurts — others. How to tell whether extended reasoning is worth it.
entries.aliases: guide 思维链什么时候有用

entries.zh: 换模型前怎么迁移评估
entries.en: How to Assess a Model Migration
entries.summaryZh: 换模型不是改个名字：同一套提示词在新模型上可能失效。这篇讲换之前要过的四道检查。
entries.summaryEn: Switching models is not renaming: the same prompt set can break on the new one. Four checks to pass before you switch.
entries.aliases: guide 换模型前怎么迁移评估

entries.summaryZh: 接口兼容不等于迁移成本为零。
entries.summaryEn: A compatible interface does not mean a zero-cost migration.
entries.aliases: guide 换模型只是改个名字

entries.zh: 接口兼容就等于行为一致
entries.en: A Compatible API Means Identical Behaviour
entries.summaryZh: 兼容保证的是请求与响应的形状。
entries.summaryEn: Compatibility guarantees the shape of requests and responses, nothing more.
entries.aliases: guide 接口兼容就等于行为一致

entries.summaryZh: 线上效果说不清是哪次改动带来的，多半因为提示词散在代码里随手改。这篇讲把提示词当代码管的最小做法。
entries.summaryEn: If you can't say which change moved your live numbers, it's usually because prompts live inside code and get edited on the fly. The minimal way to treat prompts like code.
entries.aliases: guide 提示词怎么版本化

entries.zh: 数据标注与质检怎么看
entries.en: How to Read Data Annotation and QA
entries.summaryZh: 「我们用了百万条标注数据」不说明质量。这篇讲怎么从标注者、一致性、质检流程三处看穿一份训练或评测数据的成色。
entries.summaryEn: "We used a million annotated rows" says nothing about quality. How to size up a training or eval dataset from three angles: who labeled it, how consistent they were, and how QA ran.
entries.aliases: guide 数据标注与质检怎么看

entries.en: Not Enough VRAM Means It Will Not Run
entries.summaryZh: 能不能跑与跑多快，是两个问题。
entries.summaryEn: Whether it runs and how fast it runs are two questions.
entries.aliases: guide 显存不够就跑不了

entries.summaryZh: 数据留在自己机器上，解决的是流向问题，不是义务问题。
entries.summaryEn: Keeping data on your own machines addresses where data flows, not what obligations apply.
entries.aliases: guide 本地部署就等于合规

entries.en: A High Benchmark Score Means It Works For You
entries.summaryZh: 基准只覆盖它测的那几项，与你的场景是两件事。
entries.summaryEn: A benchmark covers only what it measures — your task is a different question.
entries.aliases: guide 榜单分数高就是好用

entries.summaryZh: 误区篇说「榜单分数高不等于好用」；这篇讲怎么把榜单读出信息：谁做的、怎么测、哪里失真。
entries.summaryEn: The myth page says a high leaderboard score doesn't mean it works well; this guide shows how to squeeze real information out of a leaderboard: who runs it, how it tests, and where it distorts.

entries.zh: 注意力就是它注意到重点
entries.en: Attention Means It Notices What Matters
entries.summaryZh: 注意力是一种加权计算，不是「它在留意」。
entries.summaryEn: Attention is a weighted computation, not the model paying heed.
entries.aliases: guide 注意力就是它注意到重点

entries.summaryZh: 温度只改变随机性，不改变它知道多少。
entries.summaryEn: Temperature changes randomness only, not how much the model knows.
entries.aliases: guide 温度调高会更聪明

entries.en: How to Design a System Prompt
entries.summaryZh: 系统提示是产品行为的隐形规格书。这篇讲写什么、不写什么、怎么测它有没有生效。
entries.summaryEn: A system prompt is the invisible spec of your product's behavior. What to put in it, what to leave out, and how to test whether it actually holds.
entries.aliases: guide 系统提示怎么设计

entries.zh: 论文卡-Attention Is All You Need
entries.en: Paper Card - Attention Is All You Need
entries.summaryZh: Transformer 的源头论文。这张卡列清它要解决什么、证据在哪一节、以及它没有主张什么。
entries.summaryEn: The source paper of the Transformer. This card lays out the question it set out to solve, where the evidence lives, and what the paper does not claim.
entries.aliases: guide 论文卡-Attention Is All You Need

entries.summaryZh: 「模型该多大、数据该多少」的定标论文。这张卡列清它的结论原话、证据规模、以及作者自己提醒的外推边界。
entries.summaryEn: The calibration paper on 'how big should the model be, how much data should it see'. This card quotes the conclusion, states the evidence scale, and notes the extrapolation boundary the authors themselves flag.

entries.summaryZh: 把「一份人写的原则清单」当成监督来源的训练方法。这张卡列清它要解决什么、摘要给了哪些结论、以及它没有主张什么。
entries.summaryEn: A training method that treats a human-written list of principles as the source of supervision. This card states what it set out to solve, which conclusions the abstract supports, and what it does not claim.

entries.en: Paper Card - Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
entries.summaryZh: 把多个模型的判断压进一个更容易部署的模型——蒸馏路线的早期短文。这张卡列清它要解决什么、结论停在哪一层、以及它没有主张什么。
entries.summaryEn: Compressing the judgement of several models into one easier-to-deploy model - an early short paper on distillation. This card states the question, where the conclusions stop, and what it does not claim.

entries.summaryZh: 「大模型」叙事的起点论文。这张卡列清它真正论证了什么、局限作者自己怎么写的、以及哪些流行说法不在论文里。
entries.summaryEn: The starting point of the 'big model' narrative. This card separates what the paper actually demonstrated, what the authors themselves flagged as limits, and which popular claims are not in the paper.

entries.summaryZh: 「别只看一个总分」的评测框架论文。这张卡列清它要解决什么、框架怎么搭、以及它自己声明的取舍。
entries.summaryEn: The evaluation-framework paper behind 'don't trust a single score'. This card lays out the question, how the framework is built, and the trade-offs the authors declare.

entries.summaryZh: 「对齐」进入主流训练的标志性论文。这张卡列清它要解决什么、关键数字在哪、以及作者自己列的局限在哪一节。
entries.summaryEn: The landmark paper that moved 'alignment' into mainstream training. This card pins down the question, the key numbers, and where the authors list their own limitations.

entries.summaryZh: 「少即是多」的对齐数据实验：只用 1000 条精选样本微调。这张卡列清它要测什么、证据在哪一节、以及它没有主张什么。
entries.summaryEn: The 'less is more' alignment-data experiment: fine-tuning on just 1,000 curated examples. This card lays out what it set out to test, where the evidence sits, and what it does not claim.

entries.summaryZh: 开放权重对话模型的标志性技术报告。这张卡列清它要解决什么、证据在哪一节、以及它没有主张什么。
entries.summaryEn: The landmark tech report for open-weight chat models. This card lays out what it set out to solve, where the evidence sits, and what it does not claim.

entries.summaryZh: 合成指令数据的开山框架：让模型自己生成指令来训练自己。这张卡列清它要解决什么、证据在哪一节、以及它没有主张什么。
entries.summaryEn: The founding framework for synthetic instruction data: models generate the instructions that train them. This card lays out what it set out to solve, where the evidence sits, and what it does not claim.

entries.zh: 评测分数高就等于可靠
entries.en: A High Evaluation Score Means It Is Reliable
entries.summaryZh: 分数回答的是「在那套题上得了多少」，可靠要的是「在我这反复用会不会出格」。
entries.summaryEn: A score answers "how many points on that set"; reliability asks "what happens when I use it repeatedly".
entries.aliases: guide 评测分数高就等于可靠

entries.en: AGI Is Just Around the Corner
entries.summaryZh: 「临近」是说法，不是可核对的里程碑。
entries.summaryEn: "Soon" is a claim, not a verifiable milestone.
entries.aliases: guide 通用人工智能快到了

entries.zh: 通过一次评测就可以上线
entries.en: Passing One Evaluation Is Enough to Ship
entries.summaryZh: 上线不是通过一场考试，而是一个需要被持续检查的状态。
entries.summaryEn: Shipping is not passing one exam; it is a state that needs continuous checking.
entries.aliases: guide 通过一次评测就可以上线

entries.summaryZh: 三条路线都在「让模型变小」，但动的对象不同：量化降精度、蒸馏换学生、剪枝删结构。
entries.summaryEn: All three routes make a model smaller, but they touch different things: quantisation lowers precision, distillation swaps in a student, pruning removes structure.
entries.aliases: guide 量化、蒸馏、剪枝的区别

entries.zh: 量化会让模型变笨一半
entries.summaryZh: 影响随档位而变，量尺是每权重比特数。
entries.summaryEn: The impact varies by tier; the ruler is bits per weight.
entries.aliases: guide 量化会让模型变笨一半

entries.summaryZh: 能不能用看条款与时间表，不看名字。
entries.summaryEn: Judge it by the terms and the timeline, not by the word "preview".
entries.aliases: guide 预览版不能用于生产

entries.summaryZh: 查一个不懂的词，或选一条路线开始。第一次接触 AI，可以先读十个常用概念；已有基础，直接找你要解决的问题。
entries.summaryEn: Look up a term or choose a route. New to AI? Start with ten common concepts. If you have some background, go straight to the problem you want to solve.

entries.summaryZh: 按基础、训练、架构与生成顺序读十二个主题。重点是解释现象和限制；技术细节可在需要时回查。
entries.summaryEn: Read twelve topics across foundations, training, architecture and generation. Focus on explaining behavior and limits; revisit details when needed.

entries.summaryZh: 按搭建顺序读接口、检索、工具调用、评测与成本。阅读用于理解链路；实际接入还需按当前版本检查并验证。
entries.summaryEn: Study interfaces, retrieval, tools, evaluation and cost in build order. This explains the pipeline; actual integration still needs version checks and validation.

entries.summaryZh: 从日常使用出发，了解 AI 能做什么、哪里可能出错，再检查资料、隐私与发布要求。无需编程基础。
entries.summaryEn: Start from everyday use: learn capabilities and errors, then check sources, privacy and publication requirements. No programming background required.

entries.zh: 图像 / 视频 / 音频创作者路线
entries.en: The Image / Video / Audio Creator's Route
entries.summaryZh: 沿文字、图像、视频与声音的生成环节，检查常见失败、素材来源与发布条件。目标是能列出验收项。
entries.summaryEn: Study generation across text, image, video and sound, including failures, provenance and publication conditions. Aim to define acceptance checks.

entries.summaryZh: 从「别人报的分数」走到「你能自己复跑的判法」：先弄清评测在测什么、什么时候失效，再把它落成一套能记录、能复跑、能追责的最小流程。
entries.summaryEn: Move from other people's scores to judgements you can re-run: what an evaluation actually measures, where it fails, and how to land it as a minimal flow you can record, re-run and hold accountable.

entries.summaryZh: 把产品、部署、数据、成本与退出条件逐项拆开。目标是形成一份能说明选择原因和未知项的采购记录。
entries.summaryEn: Separate product, deployment, data, cost and exit conditions. Aim for a procurement record explaining the choice and unresolved items.

entries.summaryZh: 沿运行、监控、权限、故障与退役读十四个主题。先建立排查顺序，再用具体服务的配置与日志验证。
entries.summaryEn: Study fourteen topics covering runtime, monitoring, permissions, failure and retirement. Form an investigation order, then validate it against a service’s configuration and logs.

entries.summaryZh: 将原理词条与论文卡交替阅读。每篇都记录研究问题、证据设置和适用边界；未披露的部分保留为未知。
entries.summaryEn: Alternate concepts and paper cards. Record each research question, evidence setup and scope; leave undisclosed details unknown.

entries.en: The Safety and Compliance Review Route
entries.summaryZh: 上线前把风险面、数据面与义务面分开看：先确认会被怎样滥用，再确认数据去了哪里，最后确认你必须留下什么记录。读完应能写出一份带未知项的评审结论。
entries.summaryEn: Split the pre-launch review into risk, data and obligation: how it can be misused, where the data goes, and what records you must keep. Finish with a written review that names unresolved items.

entries.summaryZh: 围绕资料整理、写作与引用，了解生成限制和核对方法。读完后用一小段真实资料练习，而非只记提问技巧。
entries.summaryEn: Study limitations and checks for research, writing and citations. Then practice on a short source passage rather than memorizing prompting tips.

entries.summaryZh: 六站各选代表主题，共二十五步。把能力、成本、许可与评测放在一起看，最后用具体任务检查自己的选择。
entries.summaryEn: Follow twenty-five representative steps across six stations. Connect capability, cost, licensing and evaluation, then examine a choice for a concrete task.

entries.summaryZh: 先读十个常用概念，再做三道自测。目标是分清模型、产品与能力边界，不需要记住全部名词。
entries.summaryEn: Read ten common concepts, then try three questions. Aim to distinguish models, products and limits without memorizing the whole glossary.

entries.summaryZh: 让不同厂商的 AI 编码工具能挂进同一个编辑器。
entries.summaryEn: Let AI coding tools from different vendors plug into the same editor.

entries.summaryZh: 让 agent 自己决定要不要检索、检索几次、怎么改写 query，而不是一次检索就生成。
entries.summaryEn: Let the agent decide whether to retrieve, how many times, and how to rewrite the query, instead of generating after one retrieval.

entries.summaryZh: 「什么都能像人一样干」的假想 AI。实验室用来表述目标的词，目前还不存在。
entries.summaryEn: The hypothetical 'capable of anything a human can' AI: a word labs use to state their goal — it does not exist yet.

entries.zh: AI Agent 与聊天机器人的区别
entries.summaryZh: 聊天的终点是回答，Agent 的终点是做完。
entries.summaryEn: A chatbot's job ends with an answer; an agent's ends with the work being done.
entries.aliases: term AI Agent 与聊天机器人的区别

entries.zh: AI 产品 vs AI 模型
entries.summaryZh: 区分「模型本身」和「你实际用的那个软件」。
entries.summaryEn: Separate the model itself from the piece of software you actually use.
entries.aliases: term AI 产品 vs AI 模型

entries.summaryZh: 研究通用 AI 能做什么、有什么风险、怎么缓解的领域。已有政府背书的国际综述。
entries.summaryEn: The field studying what general-purpose AI can do, what risks it poses, and how to mitigate them — now with a government-backed international review.

entries.summaryZh: 不用关键词，而是用一句话描述你想要什么，直接给答案。
entries.summaryEn: Describe what you want in a sentence instead of keywords, and get an answer directly.

entries.summaryZh: 专门做 AI 运算的芯片，比通用 GPU 更高效但生态更封闭。
entries.summaryEn: Chips built specifically for AI computation — more efficient than general GPUs, but with a more closed ecosystem.
entries.aliases: AI 加速卡  term AI 芯片

entries.summaryZh: 不自己搞模型，按用量付钱调用别人的。
entries.summaryEn: Do not run a model yourself — pay per use for someone else's.

entries.summaryZh: 让同一个 AI 会话能在终端、编辑器、网页之间接力。
entries.summaryEn: Let one AI session hand off between terminal, editor and web.

entries.summaryZh: 量化档位的数值表示：平均每个权重占几个比特。
entries.summaryEn: The numeric form of a quantisation level: how many bits each weight averages.

entries.summaryZh: 让模型理解「文字描述」和「图片内容」的对应关系，是文生图的基础。
entries.summaryEn: Lets a model relate text descriptions to image content — the foundation of text-to-image generation.

entries.summaryZh: 让 AI 直接操作电脑界面：看屏幕、点按钮、输入文字，而不是只调用 API。
entries.summaryEn: Let AI operate a computer directly — read the screen, click buttons, type — instead of only calling APIs.

entries.summaryZh: 让你用线稿、深度图、姿态图精确控制生成结果。
entries.summaryEn: Gives precise control over the result using line art, depth maps or pose skeletons.

entries.summaryZh: 没有显卡也能跑模型。
entries.summaryEn: You can run models without a GPU; the cost is speed.

entries.summaryZh: 一种更省显存、更快的注意力算法，长上下文的基石。
entries.summaryEn: A more memory-efficient, faster attention algorithm; the base of long contexts.

entries.summaryZh: 本地跑模型的事实标准文件格式。llama.cpp 生态几乎只认它。
entries.summaryEn: The de facto standard file format for running models locally. The llama.cpp ecosystem accepts little else.

entries.summaryZh: 真正做矩阵运算的芯片。跑大模型靠它，CPU 很慢。
entries.summaryEn: The chip that actually does the matrix arithmetic. Large models run on it; a CPU is far too slow.
entries.aliases: 显卡 · 图形处理器  term GPU

entries.summaryZh: 把模型一部分交给 GPU、一部分留在 CPU，显存不够时的妥协手段。
entries.summaryEn: Give part of the model to the GPU and keep the rest on the CPU — the compromise when VRAM falls short.

entries.summaryZh: 让模型逐字生成时不用每一步都重算整段话，生成速度才可用。
entries.summaryEn: Stops the model recomputing the whole passage on every token it generates — this is what makes generation speed usable.

entries.summaryZh: 在普通电脑上跑大模型的主流开源引擎，CPU 也能跑。
entries.summaryEn: The mainstream open-source engine for running large models on an ordinary computer, CPU included.

entries.summaryZh: 带图形界面的本地模型应用，不用碰命令行。
entries.summaryEn: A local-model desktop app with a graphical interface — no command line needed.

entries.summaryZh: 模型每一步输出的不是词，而是整个词表的分数表。采样参数都作用在这上面。
entries.summaryEn: What the model outputs at each step is not a word but a score table over the whole vocabulary. All sampling parameters act on it.

entries.summaryZh: 省钱的微调法：冻住原权重，只训练一小块「补丁」。
entries.summaryEn: Budget fine-tuning: freeze the original weights, train only a small 'patch'.

entries.summaryZh: 一套标准接口，让 AI 用统一的方式接外部工具和数据。不用为每个服务单独适配。
entries.summaryEn: A standard interface for connecting AI to external tools and data in one uniform way, without a bespoke integration per service.
entries.aliases: 模型上下文协议  term MCP

entries.summaryZh: 苹果芯片上的机器学习框架，由 Apple 研究团队开源。
entries.summaryEn: A machine learning framework for Apple silicon, open-sourced by Apple's research team.

entries.summaryZh: 一种模型结构：每层放很多「专家」，每个词只用到其中少数几个。
entries.summaryEn: A model architecture: each layer holds many "experts," but each word uses only a few of them.

entries.summaryZh: 一条命令就在自己电脑上跑起开源模型的工具。
entries.summaryEn: A tool that runs an open model on your own computer with a single command.

entries.summaryZh: 本地跑的模型，用现成的 OpenAI 客户端就能连。
entries.summaryEn: Serve a local model so existing OpenAI clients can connect unchanged.
entries.aliases: OpenAI 兼容 API  term OpenAI 兼容接口

entries.summaryZh: 借操作系统的分页思路管理 KV 缓存，让显存几乎不浪费。
entries.summaryEn: Manage the KV cache with OS paging ideas so memory is barely wasted.

entries.summaryZh: 把重复的系统提示和资料缓存起来，重复问同一份上下文时省时间和钱。
entries.summaryEn: Cache repeated system prompts and documents, saving time and money when asking about the same context again.
entries.aliases: 提示词缓存 · 前缀缓存  term Prompt Cache

entries.summaryZh: 把模型压到 4-bit 再微调，一张消费级显卡也能练。
entries.summaryEn: Quantise the model to 4-bit first, then fine-tune — one consumer GPU is enough.

entries.summaryZh: 一种更安全的模型权重文件格式。
entries.summaryEn: A safer file format for model weights.

entries.summaryZh: 模型处理文本的最小单位。计费和长度限制都按它算。
entries.summaryEn: The smallest unit a model processes text in. Both billing and length limits are measured in it.

entries.summaryZh: 当前所有主流大模型共用的底层架构。
entries.summaryEn: The architecture underneath every mainstream large model today.

entries.summaryZh: 在服务器上高并发跑模型的服务引擎。
entries.summaryEn: A serving engine for running models at high concurrency on a server.

entries.summaryZh: 先判断这件事该不该做成自主体。
entries.summaryEn: First decide whether the job should be agentic at all.
entries.aliases: 工作流与自主体  term Workflow 还是 Agent

entries.summaryZh: 对话长到快装不下时，把前面内容总结一遍再重新开始。
entries.summaryEn: When a conversation nearly fills the window, summarize it and start again.
entries.aliases: 压缩 · 对话压缩  term 上下文压缩

entries.summaryZh: 在对话里现学现用：给几个例子，模型就会做新任务，不用重新训练。
entries.summaryEn: Learning on the spot inside a conversation: give a few examples and the model does a new task, no retraining.

entries.summaryZh: 决定「哪些内容放进模型的有限窗口」这件事本身。
entries.summaryEn: Deciding what goes into the model's limited window is itself a discipline.

entries.summaryZh: 把超长上下文拆到多张卡上分别处理。
entries.summaryEn: Split a very long context across several cards for processing.

entries.summaryZh: 模型一次能「看见」多少内容。超出部分它就完全不知道。
entries.summaryEn: How much the model can see at once — the page of text it can keep in mind while answering.
entries.aliases: 上下文 · Context  term 上下文窗口

entries.summaryZh: 上下文开得越大越慢越贵，不是免费扩容。
entries.summaryEn: A larger context window is slower and more expensive — it is not free capacity.
entries.aliases: term 上下文窗口的代价

entries.summaryZh: 用一组「不过就不放行」的条件，把安全要求变成流程里绕不过的门槛。
entries.summaryEn: Turns safety requirements into gates that block release until they pass.
entries.aliases: 上线门禁 · 放行清单  term 上线前检查门禁

entries.summaryZh: 对「专家很多但每次只激活一部分」的稀疏模型，把不常用的专家放内存里。
entries.summaryEn: For sparse models with many experts where only a few activate per token, keep the rarely-used experts in memory.

entries.summaryZh: 让模型在内部预测「世界接下来会怎样」，而不只是描述当前画面。
entries.summaryEn: Let a model predict what the world will do next, not merely describe the current frame.

entries.en: Incident Response Plan for an AI Feature
entries.summaryZh: 出事时谁在多久之内做什么、用什么手段把损害停下来。
entries.summaryEn: Say who does what, within how long, and with which lever, when an AI feature goes wrong.
entries.aliases: AI 事故预案  term 事故响应预案

entries.summaryZh: 机器判定处理不了的那部分怎么排队给人看、人看完的结论回到哪里。
entries.summaryEn: How the cases a classifier cannot settle get queued for a person, and where the human verdict goes afterwards.

entries.summaryZh: 让机器做原本需要人类智能才能做的事——看图、听话、写字、决策。
entries.summaryEn: Let machines do what used to need human intelligence — see images, understand speech, write, and decide.

entries.summaryZh: 关键步骤让人确认，而不是全自动往下跑。
entries.summaryEn: A human confirms the key steps instead of the system running on unattended.

entries.summaryZh: 让 AI 读懂整个项目，而不是只看当前打开的那一个文件。
entries.summaryEn: Let the AI read the whole project, not just the file that happens to be open.

entries.summaryZh: 在编辑器里根据上下文自动补出接下来的代码。
entries.summaryEn: Complete the following code automatically in the editor, based on context.

entries.summaryZh: 你的数据用什么方式送到模型或工具那里：留在本机还是发到第三方。
entries.summaryEn: How your data actually reaches the model or tool: staying on your machine, or going to a third party.

entries.summaryZh: 让模型知道每个词在句子里的先后顺序。
entries.summaryEn: Lets the model know the order of words in a sentence.

entries.zh: 供应商安全问卷怎么读
entries.en: How to Read a Vendor Security Questionnaire
entries.summaryZh: 从几十页问答里分清哪些回答有证据，哪些只是把「已实施」重复了三遍。
entries.summaryEn: Tells you, inside a hundred-page questionnaire, which answers rest on evidence and which just repeat "implemented".
entries.aliases: 安全问卷阅读  term 供应商安全问卷怎么读

entries.summaryZh: 用得越深，换模型或换服务商越难。
entries.summaryEn: The deeper you go, the harder it is to switch models or providers.

entries.summaryZh: 让模型的输出符合人类偏好，而不是只会续写文本。
entries.summaryEn: Makes a model's output match human preference, rather than merely continuing text.

entries.summaryZh: 模型在不同人群、语言、文化上的表现不均：源头在训练数据。
entries.summaryEn: Uneven model performance across groups, languages, and cultures — rooted in training data.

entries.summaryZh: 让 AI 有身体、能感知环境并做出动作——机器人那一套。
entries.summaryEn: Giving AI a body so it can sense its surroundings and act — the robotics side of things.

entries.summaryZh: 把长文档切成小块再送进模型。切得好不好，直接决定回答准不准。
entries.summaryEn: Cut a long document into pieces before feeding it to the model. How you chunk decides how accurate the answer is.

entries.summaryZh: 把很长的输入切成小块处理，顺便和生成中的请求混在一起跑。
entries.summaryEn: Process a long input in smaller chunks, mixing it with requests that are generating.

entries.summaryZh: Transformer 每层里的消化环节：注意力看完之后，由它加工。
entries.summaryEn: The digestion step inside every Transformer layer: attention looks around, then this part processes.

entries.summaryZh: 删掉模型里不重要的连接，让它变小变快。
entries.summaryEn: Delete the unimportant connections in a model to make it smaller and faster.

entries.summaryZh: 同一个模型，在你所在的区域可能根本没有。
entries.summaryEn: A model may simply not exist in the region you are in.

entries.summaryZh: 完成一次任务的实际花销，而不只是单价。
entries.summaryEn: What a task actually costs to run, not just the unit price.

entries.summaryZh: 模型里可调的数字，训练就是不断调整它们。参数越多，一般越「博学」。
entries.summaryEn: The numbers the training process adjusts; everything the model knows lives in them.

entries.summaryZh: 官方提供的「标准示范」实现，用来告诉你协议该怎么写。
entries.summaryEn: Official "reference" implementations showing how the protocol should be written.

entries.summaryZh: 换个模型或服务商，需要改多少东西。
entries.summaryEn: How much has to change if you swap models or providers.

entries.summaryZh: 看清模型这一趟到底做了什么、花了多少、错在哪一步。
entries.summaryEn: See what the model actually did this run, what it cost, and which step went wrong.

entries.summaryZh: 用程序或模型造出来喂训练的数据：省标注钱，但有自己的毛病。
entries.summaryEn: Data generated by programs or models to train on: saves labeling money, but has its own problems.

entries.summaryZh: 把法条与框架条款翻译成「谁在什么条件下做什么动作」的表。
entries.summaryEn: Translates statutes and framework clauses into a table of who must do what, under which conditions.
entries.aliases: 义务映射表  term 合规义务映射

entries.summaryZh: 把一段文字变成一串数字。机器于是能按「意思相近」而不是「字面相同」来检索。
entries.summaryEn: Represent text as coordinates, so meaning can be compared by geometry rather than by string match.

entries.summaryZh: 专门存和查这些数字数组的数据库。RAG 能在百万份文档里瞬间找到相关的那几段，靠的就是它。
entries.summaryEn: A database built to store and search those numeric arrays, so RAG can find the relevant passages among millions of documents in an instant.

entries.summaryZh: 每秒能生成多少字。决定长文生成要等多久。
entries.summaryEn: How many tokens per second come out. It determines how long you wait for a long generation.
entries.aliases: tokens per second · tok/s  term 吞吐

entries.summaryZh: 语言模型最常用的内在评测指标：模型对测试文本有多「意外」。
entries.summaryEn: The most common intrinsic metric for language models: how surprised the model is by test text.

entries.summaryZh: 1950 年图灵提出的经典问题：聊不出你是机器，算不算机器会思考？
entries.summaryEn: Turing's 1950 classic: if conversation can't tell machine from human, does that count as machine thinking?

entries.summaryZh: 用统一的题库横向比较模型强弱。
entries.summaryEn: Compare models on a common question set.

entries.summaryZh: 「大模型」的学术名称。指在海量数据上预训练、能适配一大堆任务的模型。
entries.summaryEn: The academic name for 'large models': pre-trained on massive data, adaptable to a wide range of tasks.

entries.summaryZh: 把一件复杂的事拆给多个各有所长的角色来分工完成。
entries.summaryEn: Split a complex job across several roles, each strong at something different.

entries.summaryZh: 让模型同时从好几个角度去看一句话，而不是只盯一种关系。
entries.summaryEn: Lets a model look at a sentence from several angles at once, instead of tracking only one kind of relation.

entries.summaryZh: 能同时看图、读文档、听声音、生成图像，不只是处理文字。
entries.summaryEn: Handle text, images, audio and video in one system rather than bolting separate models together.
entries.aliases: 多模态模型  term 多模态

entries.summaryZh: 图片、截图、音频进了模型以后，风险跟纯文本输入多了哪几块。
entries.summaryEn: What changes in the risk picture once images, screenshots and audio enter the model alongside text.

entries.zh: 大模型 / 大语言模型
entries.summaryZh: 读过海量文本、学会「接着往下写」的模型，能对话、能写作、能写代码。
entries.summaryEn: After training, the learned parameters that let a system generalise to inputs it has never seen.
entries.aliases: 大语言模型 · LLM · 语言模型  term 大模型 - 大语言模型

entries.summaryZh: 让子代理去搜，主对话只拿结论，不被细节塞满。
entries.summaryEn: Let sub-agents do the searching so the main conversation keeps only the conclusions.
entries.aliases: 子代理架构  term 子代理隔离

entries.summaryZh: 把词切成更小的碎片，让模型遇到没见过的词也能拼出来。
entries.summaryEn: Cuts words into smaller fragments so a model can still assemble words it has never seen.

entries.summaryZh: 把「你们安全做得怎么样」换成一组能核对的证据项，而不是形容词。
entries.summaryEn: Replaces "how good is your security?" with a set of evidence items you can actually check.
entries.aliases: 安全尽调  term 安全能力尽调清单

entries.summaryZh: 让调用模型的凭据不泄漏、能撤销、可追责。
entries.summaryEn: Keeps the credentials that call models from leaking, and makes them revocable and attributable.
entries.aliases: API key 管理  term 密钥与凭据管理

entries.summaryZh: 解释模型的「不肯答」是怎么被训练进去的，以及这条边界为什么会随版本移动。
entries.summaryEn: Explains how a model's habit of saying no gets trained in, and why that line moves between versions.
entries.aliases: 拒答是怎么练出来的  term 对齐与拒答训练

entries.summaryZh: 1B–8B 参数级的小个子：便宜、快、能本地跑，能力未必弱。
entries.summaryEn: The 1B–8B parameter class: cheap, fast, runnable locally — and not necessarily weak.

entries.summaryZh: 给网络每一层的输出做一次「调平」，让深层训练不失控。
entries.summaryEn: Levels out each layer's output so deep training doesn't spiral out of control.

entries.summaryZh: 把词变成数字向量的第一步，模型内部只认数字。
entries.summaryEn: The first step of turning words into numeric vectors — models only work in numbers internally.

entries.summaryZh: 把「AI 做一步、人工确认、再做下一步」这种固定流程固定下来。
entries.summaryEn: Fix a repeated pattern: the AI does a step, a human confirms, the next step runs.

entries.summaryZh: 写给模型看的「这个工具是干什么的、参数怎么填」。
entries.summaryEn: The instructions you write for the model about what a tool does and how to fill it.
entries.aliases: 工具描述 · 工具规格  term 工具定义

entries.summaryZh: 模型自己决定「我要查一下数据库」，然后真的去调那个程序。
entries.summaryEn: Let the model actually do things — search, run code, edit files — rather than only describe them.

entries.summaryZh: 看 AI 到底改了什么。这是接受 AI 代码最关键的一步。
entries.summaryEn: See exactly what the AI changed — the most important step when accepting AI-written code.

entries.summaryZh: 模型用非常自信的语气说出看起来合理、但事实错误的内容。
entries.summaryEn: The model states something plausible and confident that is simply not true.
entries.aliases: 胡说八道 · 一本正经地编  term 幻觉

entries.summaryZh: 在没有标准答案的场合，靠哪几个信号判断这段回答可能在编。
entries.summaryEn: Which signals tell you a passage is probably invented when you have no answer key to check against.

entries.summaryZh: 为什么模型会一本正经地编：不是它想骗你，是训练目标使然。
entries.summaryEn: Why models fabricate with a straight face: not deception, but the training objective.

entries.summaryZh: 权重可下载、但许可证未必算「开源」。它是介于开源与闭源之间的第三种形态。
entries.summaryEn: Weights you can download, but a license that may not qualify as 'open source' — a third form between open and closed.

entries.summaryZh: 权重公开、你可以下载下来在自己机器上跑、不用给厂商交钱。
entries.summaryEn: The weights are public: you can download them, run them on your own machine, and pay nobody.
entries.aliases: 开放权重  term 开源模型

entries.summaryZh: 模型、工具、数据、文档都由社区维护，可自由组合。
entries.summaryEn: Models, tools, data and documentation all maintained by the community, freely combinable.

entries.summaryZh: 让回答里每句话能倒查回来源、版本和原文位置，而不只是看起来有出处。
entries.summaryEn: Make every sentence in an answer traceable to a source, a version and a location rather than merely looking sourced.

entries.summaryZh: 把一个模型拆到多张卡上一起算，单卡装不下时用。
entries.summaryEn: Split one model across several GPUs when it does not fit on a single card.

entries.summaryZh: 靠奖励试错学习的范式，与监督、无监督并列的三大训练范式之一。
entries.summaryEn: Learning by trial and error against rewards: one of the three training paradigms alongside supervised and unsupervised learning.

entries.summaryZh: 拿一个已有的模型，用你自己的数据继续训练，让它更懂你的领域。
entries.summaryEn: Teach an existing model a specific task or style, rather than describing the task in the prompt.

entries.summaryZh: 让模型先列推理步骤再给答案的提示方式，以及它对模型规模的依赖。
entries.summaryEn: Prompting the model to lay out reasoning steps before answering — and its dependence on model scale.

entries.summaryZh: 把多个基准的分数加权成一个总分，方便快速比较。
entries.summaryEn: Collapse several benchmark scores into one number for quick comparison.
entries.aliases: term 总分 - 综合评测

entries.summaryZh: 为一个AI 方案实际要花多少钱。除了单价，还有你消耗掉的数量。
entries.summaryEn: What an AI approach actually costs. Beyond unit price there is also how much you consume.

entries.summaryZh: 生成图片的主流方法：从一片噪声一步步「擦」出图像。
entries.summaryEn: The dominant method for image generation: "wipe" an image out of noise step by step.

entries.summaryZh: 生图主流方法在原理层长什么样：加噪、去噪、预测噪声。
entries.summaryEn: What the mainstream image-generation method looks like at the principle level: add noise, remove noise, predict noise.
entries.aliases: term 扩散模型怎么生成

entries.summaryZh: 把重复的工作流程打包成可复用的能力。
entries.summaryEn: Package a repetitive workflow into a reusable capability.

entries.summaryZh: 用小模型先猜几个词，大模型一次验证，生成更快。
entries.summaryEn: Guess several tokens cheaply, then have the big model verify them in one pass.
entries.aliases: 推测解码  term 投机解码

entries.summaryZh: 限制模型能做什么、不能做什么，防止它跑偏或做危险操作。
entries.summaryEn: Constrain what the model may and may not do, so it does not drift or take dangerous actions.

entries.summaryZh: 在模型外面加一层检查和拦截，写清它拦什么、按什么阈值拦、拦不住什么。
entries.summaryEn: What an outer layer of checks actually blocks, at what threshold, and what it still misses.

entries.summaryZh: 模型对某些请求直接拒绝回答：安全对齐的直接产物。
entries.summaryEn: The model flatly declines certain requests: a direct product of safety alignment.

entries.summaryZh: 代码一提交就自动跑测试和检查。
entries.summaryEn: Tests and checks run automatically as soon as code is committed.

entries.summaryZh: 训练完之后，真正拿来回答你问题的过程。
entries.summaryEn: The model you trained is now answering real queries — a different phase with different costs.

entries.summaryZh: 模型每回答一次要花的钱，由输入和输出的 token 量决定。
entries.summaryEn: What a model costs per answer, determined by how many tokens go in and come out.

entries.en: Access Control for an Inference Service
entries.summaryZh: 决定谁能调你的模型服务、以什么身份调、能用多少、事后能不能查。
entries.summaryEn: Decides who may call your model service, in what identity, within what budget, and whether it can be traced afterwards.
entries.aliases: 谁能动我的模型服务  term 推理服务的访问控制

entries.summaryZh: 回答前先在内部「想」一串步骤，复杂问题的正确率明显更高。
entries.summaryEn: Works through a chain of internal steps before answering, which markedly improves accuracy on hard problems.
entries.aliases: 思考模型 · 带思考的模型  term 推理模型

entries.summaryZh: 外部内容里藏着指令，骗AI 执行你没打算让它做的事。
entries.summaryEn: The main security risk in agent systems: content that talks the model into doing something you did not intend.

entries.summaryZh: 你给模型的指令。说得越具体，模型的输出越准。
entries.summaryEn: The instructions you give the model, and often the main lever you actually control.

entries.summaryZh: 把一件事拆成固定的几步，每步的输出喂给下一步。
entries.summaryEn: Split a job into fixed steps, feeding each output into the next.
entries.aliases: 链式提示 · 步骤链  term 提示链

entries.zh: 插件与 MCP 的信任边界
entries.summaryZh: 装一个 server 或插件时，你到底把哪些东西交给了别人，边界画在哪。
entries.summaryEn: When you install a server or plugin, what exactly are you handing to someone else and where the boundary sits.
entries.aliases: term 插件与 MCP 的信任边界

entries.summaryZh: 有形象和声音的虚拟人，可用于客服、虚拟主播等场景。
entries.summaryEn: A virtual person with an appearance and a voice, used for customer service, virtual presenters and similar.

entries.summaryZh: 你的资料完全不经过第三方。这是很多场景的硬性要求。
entries.summaryEn: Your material never passes through a third party. This is a hard requirement in many situations.

entries.summaryZh: 把你的资料能离开机器的几条实际路线列出来，知道关掉哪一条最省事。
entries.summaryEn: List the concrete routes by which your material can leave your machine or your tenant, so you know which one is cheapest to close.

entries.summaryZh: 评测题混进训练数据，模型「考过原题」——评测分数因此失真。
entries.summaryEn: Eval questions leaking into training data — models have 'seen the exam', so scores become distorted.

entries.summaryZh: 你的数据存在哪个区域，由谁决定。
entries.summaryEn: Which region your data sits in, and who decides.
entries.aliases: 数据驻留地  term 数据驻留

entries.summaryZh: 分清「数据存在哪个区域」和「数据凭什么可以离开这个区域」。
entries.summaryEn: Separates "which region stores the data" from "on what legal basis may it leave that region".
entries.aliases: 数据会不会出境  term 数据驻留与出境

entries.summaryZh: 现代 TTS 的原理：端到端一步出波形，节奏是「猜」出来的分布。
entries.summaryEn: How modern TTS works end to end: one model outputs the waveform, and rhythm is a distribution it samples rather than an average.
entries.aliases: term 文字怎么变成声音

entries.summaryZh: 打字变图片：扩散模型最出圈的应用，从像素空间搬进潜空间才变得可用。
entries.summaryEn: Typing turns into pictures: diffusion's most visible application — practical only after moving from pixel space to latent space.

entries.summaryZh: 不给答案，让机器自己在数据里找结构。
entries.summaryEn: No answers given — the machine finds structure in the data by itself.

entries.summaryZh: 你的提示词、文件内容、工具参数会被谁存下来、存多久、谁能看到。
entries.summaryEn: Who stores your prompts, file contents and tool arguments, for how long, and who can look at them.
entries.aliases: term 日志里留下了什么

entries.summaryZh: 显卡上的内存。装不下模型就是硬装不下，跟别的无关。
entries.summaryEn: Memory on the graphics card. If the model does not fit, it simply does not run — nothing else matters.

entries.summaryZh: 让模型不止回答，还能自己动手。调工具、查资料、写文件，循环执行直到完成。
entries.summaryEn: Stop answering and start acting: let the model take multi-step actions on its own.
entries.aliases: 智能体 · 代理  term 智能体 - Agent

entries.summaryZh: 依赖别人的服务意味着它可能涨价、下线或限流。
entries.summaryEn: Depending on someone else's service means it may raise prices, shut down, or rate-limit you.

entries.summaryZh: 模型下载到自己机器上跑，数据不外发。
entries.summaryEn: Download the model and run it on your own machine, so data never leaves.

entries.en: Isolation Surfaces of a Local Deployment
entries.summaryZh: 说清模型跑在自己机器上时，到底哪些面被切断了、哪些面一点没变。
entries.summaryEn: States plainly what running a model on your own machine cuts off, and what it leaves untouched.
entries.aliases: 本地不等于隔离  term 本地部署的隔离面

entries.summaryZh: 不手写规则，直接给机器大量例子，让它自己总结规律。
entries.summaryEn: Instead of writing rules by hand, let the machine find patterns in data.

entries.summaryZh: 让摄像头「看懂」画面——识别人、物体、文字、动作。
entries.summaryEn: Lets a camera "see" — recognise people, objects, text and actions.

entries.summaryZh: 决定这个工具能碰你的哪些东西：读文件、改代码、发请求、花钱。
entries.summaryEn: The set of operations a tool is allowed to perform. Wider is more convenient and more dangerous.

entries.summaryZh: 模型报出的自信程度，经常高于它的实际正确率：自信不等于对。
entries.summaryEn: A model's stated confidence often exceeds its actual accuracy: confident is not the same as correct.

entries.summaryZh: 先确认检索有没有把该找到的段落捞上来，再讨论生成写得好不好。
entries.summaryEn: Check whether retrieval surfaced the right passage before debating how well the model wrote about it.

entries.summaryZh: 模型的「说明书」：用途、实测表现、已知短板，发布时该一起给。
entries.summaryEn: A model's 'spec sheet': intended use, measured performance, known shortcomings — issued with the model.

entries.summaryZh: 把「这段输出像哪个模型做的」「这个模型是从哪来的」拆成两类可查的技术问题。
entries.summaryEn: Splits "which model wrote this?" and "where did this model come from?" into two separable technical questions.
entries.aliases: 哪个模型生成的  term 模型指纹与溯源

entries.summaryZh: 同一个模型名后面那串日期和 mini、nano，含义不同。
entries.summaryEn: The date and the mini/nano suffix in a model name mean different things.
entries.aliases: 模型家族 · 模型版本  term 模型版本与变体

entries.summaryZh: 知道榜单分数不等于你的实际效果，这点很重要。
entries.summaryEn: A leaderboard score is not the same as your actual result — this matters.

entries.summaryZh: 云端模型会被下线，这是选型时要算的风险。
entries.summaryEn: Cloud models get retired; treat it as a selection risk.
entries.aliases: 模型下线 · 弃用与退役  term 模型退役

entries.summaryZh: 给网络留一条「直通通道」，让信号穿过很多层也不丢失。
entries.summaryEn: Gives the network a "pass-through lane" so the signal survives passing through many layers.

entries.summaryZh: 识别 AI 生成内容的两条路：嵌进内容的水印，和记录出处的元数据。
entries.summaryEn: Two routes to identify AI-generated content: watermarks embedded in the content, provenance metadata beside it.

entries.summaryZh: 把 AI 的操作关在一个受控环境里，出问题也出不到外面。
entries.summaryEn: Confine what the AI does to a controlled environment so a mistake stays contained.

entries.summaryZh: 模型对没见过的数据也表现好，这才叫学会了。
entries.summaryEn: A model has truly learned only when it performs well on data it has never seen.
entries.aliases: 举一反三  term 泛化

entries.summaryZh: 让模型在处理一个词时，自动看向句子里最相关的其他词。
entries.summaryEn: When processing one word, the model automatically looks at the most relevant other words in the sentence.

entries.summaryZh: 回答边生成边推送：你看到逐字出现，而不是等全文算完。
entries.summaryEn: Answers stream out as they are generated: you read word by word instead of waiting for the full text.

entries.summaryZh: 把模型按层切成几段，分别放在不同显卡上接力算。
entries.summaryEn: Cut the model into layer ranges and run them on different GPUs in relay.

entries.summaryZh: 在推理阶段多花算力换质量：多采样、多步推理、搜索与验证。
entries.summaryEn: Spend more compute at inference time to buy quality: more samples, more reasoning steps, search and verification.

entries.summaryZh: 让 AI 自己去点页面、填表单、截图取信息。
entries.summaryEn: Let the AI click pages, fill forms and take screenshots to gather information.
entries.aliases: term 浏览 - 网页操作

entries.summaryZh: 小模型没有、大模型突然会了的能力——以及它可能是评测假象的争论。
entries.summaryEn: Abilities small models lack that large models suddenly have — and the dispute that they may be a metric artifact.

entries.summaryZh: 用生成模型造出以假乱真的真人音视频：眼见不再为实。
entries.summaryEn: Generative models producing indistinguishable fake video and audio of real people: seeing is no longer believing.

entries.summaryZh: 用很多层「神经元」叠起来的网络，从数据里学出复杂特征。
entries.summaryEn: Stack many layers so the network learns its own features instead of being told them.

entries.summaryZh: 控制模型输出的随机性。调低更稳，调高更有创意。
entries.summaryEn: Controls how random the output is. Lower is steadier; higher is more creative.

entries.summaryZh: 图像生成的关键机制——模型在压缩后的空间里处理，而不是原始像素。
entries.summaryEn: The key mechanism in image generation — the model works in a compressed space, not on raw pixels.

entries.summaryZh: 记录每一次改动，随时回退。这是 AI 编程的安全底座。
entries.summaryEn: Record every change and roll back at will — the safety foundation of AI-assisted coding.

entries.summaryZh: 能凭空产出新内容的 AI——文字、图片、音频、视频都算。
entries.summaryEn: AI that produces new content from nothing — text, images, audio, video all count.

entries.zh: 生成式 AI 合规义务
entries.summaryZh: 面向境内公众提供生成式 AI 服务要遵守的具体义务。
entries.summaryEn: The specific duties when serving generative AI to the public in China.
entries.aliases: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法  term 生成式 AI 合规义务

entries.summaryZh: 给机器带答案的练习题，让它学会从题目推答案。
entries.summaryEn: Give the machine practice questions with answers, so it learns to derive answers from inputs.

entries.summaryZh: 模型训练数据的时间边界。边界之后的事它不知道。
entries.summaryEn: The date boundary of a model's training data. Anything after it, the model does not know.

entries.summaryZh: 用大模型的软输出训练小模型：能力保留大半，部署容易得多。
entries.summaryEn: Train a small model on a big model's soft outputs: keep most of the capability, deploy far more easily.

entries.summaryZh: 出问题能不能找到人问，接口有没有写清楚的文档。
entries.summaryEn: When something breaks, can you find someone to ask, and is the API properly documented.

entries.summaryZh: 模仿大脑神经元连接方式的一类数学结构，是现代 AI 的通用积木。
entries.summaryEn: A network of simple units whose combined output can approximate very complex functions.

entries.summaryZh: 分清上线前跑固定题集和上线后看真实流量，各自能证明什么、证明不了什么。
entries.summaryEn: Separate rerunning a fixed dataset before launch from scoring real traffic after it, and see what each can and cannot prove.
entries.aliases: term 离线评测与在线评测

entries.summaryZh: 给模型设定的角色和规则，决定它整个对话的基调。
entries.summaryEn: The role and rules set for a model, which determine the tone of the whole conversation.

entries.summaryZh: 发布前雇人主动攻击模型找漏洞：安全声明背后的实际工序。
entries.summaryEn: Hiring people to attack a model before release to find holes: the real process behind safety claims.

entries.summaryZh: 在命令行里自主执行任务：改文件、跑测试、提交代码。
entries.summaryEn: Run tasks autonomously in the command line: edit files, run tests, commit code.

entries.summaryZh: 让模型的回答是严格的格式（JSON 等），而不是一段散文。
entries.summaryEn: Make the model's answer a strict format (JSON and the like) rather than a paragraph of prose.

entries.summaryZh: 重复的内容不重复计算，直接复用。这是降本的第一手段。
entries.summaryEn: Do not recompute repeated content; reuse it directly. The first lever for cutting cost.

entries.summaryZh: 几种被官方命名的固定协作结构。
entries.summaryEn: A few officially named collaboration structures you can reuse.
entries.aliases: 并行化 · 编排者—执行者 · 评估者—优化者  term 编排模式

entries.summaryZh: Transformer 的两种半机：一个读懂，一个生成。
entries.summaryEn: The two halves of a Transformer: one reads, one generates.

entries.summaryZh: 损失随参数、数据、算力呈幂律下降的经验规律。它是大模型军备竞赛的理论依据。
entries.summaryEn: The empirical power-law by which loss falls with parameters, data, and compute — the theory behind the scaling arms race.

entries.summaryZh: 回答之前先去查资料，把查到的内容塞进上下文里再回答。
entries.summaryEn: Let the model look things up before answering, instead of answering from memory alone.
entries.aliases: RAG · 检索增强  term 联网 - 检索增强

entries.summaryZh: 知道模型明确做不到什么，比知道它能做什么更能避免踩坑。
entries.summaryEn: Knowing precisely what a model cannot do prevents more mistakes than knowing what it can.

entries.summaryZh: 人这头的毛病：AI 说得顺畅，人就懒得检查照单全收。
entries.summaryEn: The human-side flaw: smooth AI output makes people skip checking and accept it wholesale.

entries.summaryZh: 车辆自己识别环境、规划路线并控制方向盘。
entries.summaryEn: The vehicle senses its surroundings, plans a route and controls the steering itself.

entries.summaryZh: 大模型「一个字一个字往外蹦」的生成方式，很多下游问题的根源。
entries.summaryEn: How large models emit text one token at a time — the root of many downstream issues.

entries.summaryZh: 本地跑不花钱，但硬件、电费、运维都是真实成本。
entries.summaryEn: Running locally costs no per-token fee, but hardware, electricity and operations are real costs.

entries.summaryZh: 说明小模型的能力从哪个已有模型学来，以及这条来源线为什么常常说不清。
entries.summaryEn: Where a small model's capability came from, and why that lineage is often impossible to confirm.
entries.aliases: 能力从哪来  term 蒸馏与知识来源

entries.summaryZh: 从文字或图片生成短视频片段。
entries.summaryEn: Generating short video clips from text or images.

entries.summaryZh: 视频生成不是「逐帧生图」那么简单：时间一致性才是难点。
entries.summaryEn: Video generation is not simply 'generate one frame at a time': temporal consistency is the hard part.
entries.aliases: term 视频生成是怎么做的

entries.summaryZh: 让模型从数据里学会规律，产出这个模型。
entries.summaryEn: Let the system learn its parameters from data by repeated exposure.

entries.summaryZh: 聊天模型是怎么练成的：先会续写，再学会好好回答。
entries.summaryEn: How chat models are trained: first they learn to continue text, then they learn to answer well.

entries.summaryZh: 欧盟要求通用模型公开「训练用了哪些内容」的摘要。
entries.summaryEn: The EU requires general-purpose model providers to publish a summary of training content.

entries.summaryZh: 训练和推理都要烧算力，这是 AI 最硬的资源门槛。
entries.summaryEn: Both training and inference burn compute. This is AI's hardest resource threshold.

entries.summaryZh: 模型「读过」的海量文本汇编：它的来源和毛病，决定了模型的一切表现。
entries.summaryEn: The massive text compilation a model has 'read': its sources and flaws shape everything the model does.

entries.summaryZh: 把数据分成两堆：一堆用来练，一堆留着考试。
entries.summaryEn: Split the data into two piles: one to practice with, one kept for the exam.
entries.aliases: 训练数据 · 测试数据  term 训练集与测试集

entries.summaryZh: 让 Agent 跨对话记住事，不用每次都重新交代背景。
entries.summaryEn: Let an agent remember things across conversations instead of restating the background every time.

entries.summaryZh: 规定你能不能用、能不能改、能不能商用。选型时最容易忽略的约束。
entries.summaryEn: What you may do with it: use, modify, or commercialise. The constraint most often overlooked during selection.

entries.summaryZh: 判断一个方案到底好不好，而不是「看起来不错」。
entries.summaryEn: Decide whether an approach is actually good, rather than merely plausible-sounding.

entries.summaryZh: 把「感觉变好了」变成一份能重复跑的题集，加上明确的判分规则。
entries.summaryEn: Turn a feeling of improvement into a fixed set of tasks with scoring rules anyone can run again.

entries.summaryZh: 基准被刷到接近满分、失去区分度——榜单为什么需要持续更新。
entries.summaryEn: Benchmarks approach perfect scores and lose discriminating power — why leaderboards need constant renewal.

entries.summaryZh: 模型认识的全部字符集合。大小决定了它懂不懂中文、懂不懂代码。
entries.summaryEn: The full set of characters a model knows. Its size decides whether it handles Chinese or code well.

entries.summaryZh: 几秒录音就能合成某人声音：原理是「声纹向量」与「读文本」分开训练。
entries.summaryEn: A few seconds of recording is enough to synthesise someone's voice: the principle is training 'voiceprint vector' and 'reading text' separately.
entries.aliases: term 语音克隆是怎么做的

entries.summaryZh: 把文字读出来。
entries.summaryEn: Read text out loud.
entries.aliases: TTS · 文字转语音  term 语音合成

entries.summaryZh: 把说的话转成文字。
entries.summaryEn: Turn what was said into text.
entries.aliases: ASR · 语音转文字  term 语音识别

entries.summaryZh: 把话转成文字的主流做法：弱监督大规模训练，一个模型听多种口音。
entries.summaryEn: The mainstream way to turn speech into text: large-scale weak supervision, one model for many accents.
entries.aliases: term 语音识别是怎么听的

entries.summaryZh: 每步都选最可能词的解码方式，以及它为什么反而写出空洞重复的文本。
entries.summaryEn: Decoding that always picks the most likely token — and why it instead produces hollow, repetitive text.
entries.aliases: term 贪心解码与束搜索

entries.summaryZh: 绕过模型安全护栏的提示手法：对齐不是保险箱。
entries.summaryEn: Prompting tricks that bypass a model's safety guardrails: alignment is not a safe.

entries.summaryZh: 简单问题派给便宜快的模型，难问题派给强模型。
entries.summaryEn: Send easy questions to a cheap fast model and hard ones to a strong model.

entries.summaryZh: 看清模型什么时候会拒绝、什么时候会多做，知道自己该期待哪一种反应。
entries.summaryEn: See which requests a model will decline, which it will answer only partly, and when it does more than you asked for.

entries.summaryZh: 换模型时该怎么做决定，而不是等供应商推荐。
entries.summaryEn: How to decide on a new model instead of waiting for the vendor's recommendation.

entries.summaryZh: 把练习题背熟了，换一套新题就不会做。
entries.summaryEn: Memorized the practice questions, then fails a different set of questions.

entries.summaryZh: 云端 Agent 在你电脑上跑任务，关掉笔记本也不中断。
entries.summaryEn: A cloud agent runs tasks on your machine, so closing the laptop does not stop it.

entries.summaryZh: 让服务器把不同时刻到达的请求拼在一起算，而不是排队。
entries.summaryEn: The server batches requests that arrived at different moments instead of queueing them.

entries.summaryZh: 项目更新有多快，版本是否稳定。
entries.summaryEn: How fast the project moves and how stable its versions are.

entries.summaryZh: 不用了，迁移走要付出多少。
entries.summaryEn: What it costs to migrate away when you stop using it.

entries.summaryZh: API 对你单位时间能发多少请求的配额。
entries.summaryEn: The quota on how many requests you may send in a time window.
entries.aliases: 限流 · 429  term 速率限制

entries.summaryZh: AI 作为编程搭档，实时参与开发过程。
entries.summaryEn: AI as a programming partner taking part in development in real time.

entries.summaryZh: 模型在多个候选词里怎么挑，决定输出的发散程度。
entries.summaryEn: How the model picks among candidate tokens — this determines how far the output diverges.
entries.aliases: term 采样 - 采样参数

entries.summaryZh: 把模型权重从高精度压成低精度，省显存、提速，代价是质量下降。
entries.summaryEn: Compress model weights from high to low precision, saving VRAM and speeding things up at the cost of quality.

entries.summaryZh: 把模型压小不是只有一种做法，不同方法效果不同。
entries.summaryEn: Shrinking a model has more than one method, and the methods differ in results.
entries.aliases: GPTQ · AWQ  term 量化方法

entries.summaryZh: 让模型一次读入几十万字的技术，和它为什么贵。
entries.summaryEn: The technology behind reading hundreds of thousands of words at once — and why it is expensive.

entries.summaryZh: 跑几小时甚至几天、跨多个上下文的复杂工作。
entries.summaryEn: Work running for hours or days across many contexts.

entries.summaryZh: 你不拿到权重，只能通过官方接口调用。
entries.summaryEn: You do not get the weights; you can only call it through the official interface.

entries.summaryZh: 数据经过哪些机器、留存多久、有没有审计。
entries.summaryEn: Which machines data passes through, how long it is retained, and whether it is audited.

entries.summaryZh: 把你输入的那一整段先读完，再开始生成回答的那一步。
entries.summaryEn: The step where your whole input is read through before generation begins.

entries.summaryZh: 模型 API 的两种成熟度，决定能不能上生产。
entries.summaryEn: Two maturity levels of a model API, deciding whether it belongs in production.
entries.aliases: Preview · GA  term 预览版与正式版

entries.summaryZh: 在海量文本上做「预测下一个词」，这是模型学到世界知识的阶段。
entries.summaryEn: Predicting the next token over vast text — the stage where a model absorbs world knowledge.

entries.summaryZh: 从发出提问到看到第一个字要多久。这个数字决定「感觉快不快」。
entries.summaryEn: How long from sending a question to seeing the first word. This number decides whether it feels fast.

entries.summaryZh: AIVA 是「整曲生成 + MIDI 可编辑」的网页配乐助手（AIVA Limited，当日直抓在册）： 250+ 风格叙事主打，版权按档位分层——免费档版权归平台限四平台变现，Pro 才永久完整版权。
entries.summaryEn: AIVA is a web music-generation assistant built around full-song generation + editable MIDI (AIVA Limited, on record same day): the 250+ styles pitch leads, and copyright is tier-split — free tier stays owned by the platform with four-platform monetization only, Pro grants full copyright forever.

entries.summaryZh: AssemblyAI 是「转写+理解」一体化的语音 API：转写之上做摘要/实体/问答（LeMUR 线）， 文档化体验是它的开发者口碑；与 Deepgram 的实时性能叙事错位竞争。
entries.summaryEn: AssemblyAI is the 'transcription + understanding' speech API: summarization/entities/Q&A on top of transcripts (the LeMUR line); documentation experience is its developer reputation — offset competition with Deepgram's real-time performance narrative.

entries.summaryZh: Cartesia 是「实时低延迟 TTS（Sonic）+ 转录模型（Ink）+ 托管语音 agent」三线平台 （Cartesia AI, Inc.，条款当日在册）：44 语言语音面，voice agent 底座场景（客服/外呼/招聘筛选）主打。
entries.summaryEn: Cartesia is a three-line platform: realtime low-latency TTS (Sonic) + transcription model (Ink) + managed voice agents (Cartesia AI, Inc., on record same day): 44-language speech coverage, voice-agent infrastructure (support/outbound/recruiting) is the pitch.

entries.summaryZh: CosyVoice 是阿里语音团队（QwenAudio/原 FunAudioLLM）的开源 LLM-TTS 模型族（Apache-2.0， v1→v2→Fun-CosyVoice 3.0 三代线）：下载权重本机推理/训练/部署全栈，中文+方言覆盖与 zero-shot 克隆是主打—— 它是模型不是产品，官方不卖托管线。
entries.summaryEn: CosyVoice is the Alibaba speech team's (QwenAudio, formerly FunAudioLLM) open-source LLM-TTS model family (Apache-2.0, three generations v1 → v2 → Fun-CosyVoice 3.0): download the weights and run inference/training/deployment locally — Chinese + dialect coverage and zero-shot cloning are the pitch; it is a model, not a

entries.summaryZh: Deepgram 是开发者向的语音 API 平台：Nova 转写 + Aura TTS 双线，实时流式转写是主打； 它是「造语音产品」的底座，不是终端转写产品。
entries.summaryEn: Deepgram is the developer-facing speech API platform: Nova transcription + Aura TTS, real-time streaming is the lead; it's the base for building speech products, not an end-user transcription product.

entries.summaryZh: 语音合成与配音平台：TTS、克隆、转写、对话 AI、工作流编排一条齐； 「训练退出是自助菜单」在同类里少见，商用权与档位绑定。
entries.summaryEn: The broadest product surface in speech synthesis and voiceover: TTS, cloning, transcription, conversational AI and workflow orchestration in one place; “the training opt-out is a self-serve menu” is rare among peers, and commercial rights are tier-bound.

entries.summaryZh: F5-TTS 是中国学术团队（上交 X-LANCE 等）的开源 flow-matching TTS 模型（MIT，★15,487， 最近推送 2026-10-23 当日在册）：下载权重本机跑，中英文 zero-shot 克隆是主打用法，无官方托管服务。
entries.summaryEn: F5-TTS is an open-source flow-matching TTS model from Chinese academic teams (SJTU X-LANCE et al.) (MIT, ★15,487, last push 2026-10-23 on record): download the weights and run locally, Chinese + English zero-shot cloning is the lead use, no official hosted service.

entries.summaryZh: fish audio 是 zero-shot 音色克隆向的 TTS 台：上传样本即复刻音色 + 社区音色市场； 「能用」与「合规」之间隔着授权红线。
entries.summaryEn: fish audio is the zero-shot voice-clone TTS console: upload a sample and the voice is cloned + a community voice market; between 'it works' and 'it's compliant' sits the consent red line.

entries.summaryZh: 音频生成与转写产品：音乐生成、语音合成（TTS）、语音转写。声音克隆涉及人格权，permissions 维必须写清官方授权要求；开源模型（如 Whisper）按「模型不是产品」口径建档。
entries.summaryEn: Audio generation and transcription products: music, TTS, speech-to-text. Voice cloning touches personality rights, so the permissions axis must state the official consent requirements; open-source models (Whisper, say) are filed under the "a model is not a product" rule.

entries.summaryZh: MiniMax Audio 是国产 TTS/声音克隆/API 三合一的音频线：中文语音质量口碑 + 音色克隆 + 音乐模型经 API 供给；网页与 API 两套入口两套条款。
entries.summaryEn: MiniMax Audio is the domestic TTS/voice-clone/API three-in-one audio line: strong Chinese speech quality + voice cloning + music models served via API; web and API are two entries with two sets of terms.

entries.summaryZh: 魔音工坊是出门问问的中文配音工作台：多音色文本配音+声音复刻+视频配音工作流， 算法备案在案；国内直连、中文客服面是它对国产用户的便利面。
entries.summaryEn: Moyin Workshop is Mobvoi's Chinese dubbing workbench: multi-voice text-to-speech + voice cloning + video-dubbing workflows, algorithm filing on record; domestic direct access and Chinese support are its convenience surface.

entries.summaryZh: Murf 是「配音工作室 + TTS API + 语音 agent」三线一体的商用语音平台（官网当日招牌已转向 AI Voice & Conversational Agent Platform）：200+ 预置音色主打，克隆是辅线，API 文档与 changelog 公开可核。
entries.summaryEn: Murf is a commercial voice platform combining a dubbing studio, a TTS API and voice agents (the site's headline pivoted same-day to "AI Voice & Conversational Agent Platform"): 200+ stock voices are the lead, cloning is a side line, and the API docs + changelog are public and verifiable.

entries.summaryZh: Otter 是「机器人入会」的会议转写纪要产品：实时转写+行动项+跨会议问答，英文向成熟； 机器人进你的会议这件事本身要过合规。
entries.summaryEn: Otter is the bot-joins-the-meeting transcription & notes product: real-time transcription + action items + cross-meeting Q&A, mature for English; the bot entering your meeting is itself a compliance question.

entries.summaryZh: Resemble AI 已从「声音克隆厂商」整体转向「多模态深伪检测与水印」企业平台（官网当日招牌在册）： 检测（RAD-S1/DETECT-World）、水印（PerTh/C2PA）、身份注册三线；生成语音线转入开源研究归档、不再商用售卖。
entries.summaryEn: Resemble AI has pivoted wholesale from “voice cloning vendor” to an enterprise multimodal deepfake-detection & watermarking platform (same-day headline on record): detection (RAD-S1/DETECT-World), watermarking (PerTh/C2PA), identity enrollment; the generative voice line moved to an open-source research archive and is n

entries.summaryZh: SOUNDRAW 是「只用自建曲库训练」叙事主打的免版税 AI beat 生成器（SOUNDRAW Inc.，条款当日在册）： 按情绪/风格/时长快速出器乐配乐，Mixer 逐轨可改，主打视频创作者场景。
entries.summaryEn: SOUNDRAW is a royalty-free AI beat generator pitching “trained only on music we create in-house” (SOUNDRAW Inc., on record same day): pick/edit instrumental tracks by mood/genre/length with a per-track Mixer, aimed at video creators.

entries.summaryZh: AI 音乐生成平台：歌曲、人声、Voice Model 与 Suno Studio 工作站； 「商用绑定付费下载配额、Remix 一律非商用」是许可条款里最具体的分层。
entries.summaryEn: An AI-music generation platform: songs, vocals, Voice Models and the Suno Studio workstation; “commercial use is tied to the paid-download quota, Remix is always non-commercial” is the most concrete licensing split in the terms.

entries.summaryZh: Udio 是音乐生成双雄的另一半（v1.5 Allegro 线，复杂曲风口碑）， 现在正处「版权被告→授权平台」的转型期——UMG/WMG 已和解，新平台走 walled garden 路线。
entries.summaryEn: Udio is the other half of the music-generation duo (v1.5 Allegro line, complex-genre reputation), now mid-transition from copyright defendant to licensed platform — UMG/WMG have settled, the new platform goes walled-garden.

entries.summaryZh: Whisper 是转写领域的「开源基座」：MIT 权重多档位本地跑，隐私敏感音频不出本机； 它是模型不是产品——会议记录体验要壳件，说话人分离靠衍生生态。
entries.summaryEn: Whisper is the open-source base of transcription: MIT weights in multiple sizes run locally, privacy-sensitive audio never leaves the machine; it's a model, not a product — meeting-note UX needs a shell, diarization needs derivative tooling.

entries.summaryZh: Activepieces 是开源低代码自动化平台：主体 MIT Expat，只有 ee/ 目录是商业许可区—— 比 n8n 的 SUL 宽松，代价是连接器体量小得多。自托管 + 官方云两条线。
entries.summaryEn: Activepieces is an open-source low-code automation platform: MIT Expat for the main body, only the ee/ directory is the commercial-license zone — looser than n8n's SUL, at the cost of a much smaller connector catalog. Self-hosted + official cloud, two lines.

entries.summaryZh: Agentforce 是 Salesforce 生态内的企业 agent 平台——价值锚点是 CRM 记录与 Data Cloud 天然上下文： 客服/销售场景里「agent 知道客户的一切」是通用平台给不了的结构性优势。出了 Salesforce 生态，锚点消失。
entries.summaryEn: Agentforce is Salesforce's in-ecosystem enterprise agent platform — its value anchor is CRM records and Data Cloud as natural context: “the agent knows everything about the customer” in service/sales scenarios is a structural advantage general platforms cannot give. Outside the Salesforce ecosystem, the anchor disappea

entries.zh: AutoGPT（现 Experts AI 团队平台）
entries.summaryZh: AutoGPT 现役形态是「你的 AI 专家团队」（首页当日招牌：Your team of AI Experts——按职位分工的 AI SDR/SEO writer/LinkedIn 写手/执行助理，由 Otto 协调）：托管平台 platform.agpt.co + 开源自托管双路径， 仓 ★187,826 当日核验；从 2023 自主 agent 实验到低代码平台再到 Experts，产品线两度转向， classic 线仍在仓但已非主打——按任何一代旧印象建档都会错位。
entries.summaryEn: AutoGPT's current form is "your team of AI Experts" (same-day homepage headline: Your team of AI Experts — role-based AI SDR / SEO writer / LinkedIn writer / executive assistant, coordinated by Otto): hosted platform platform.agpt.co + open-source self-hosting, repo ★187,826 verified same day; from the 2023 autonomous-

entries.summaryZh: Bedrock 的 agent 线是 AWS 的托管 agent 平台：Agents（可视化编排）+ AgentCore（框架无关的托管运行时）两条线。 一个 URL 事实：旧入口 bedrock/agent/ 已 404（2026-10-21 直抓核验）——现行是 agents/ 与 agentcore/。
entries.summaryEn: The Bedrock agent line is AWS's hosted agent platform: Agents (visual orchestration) + AgentCore (framework-agnostic hosted runtime), two lines. One URL fact: the old entry bedrock/agent/ is now 404 (direct-fetched 2026-10-21) — current entries are agents/ and agentcore/.

entries.summaryZh: Botpress 是企业向客服场景的 AI agent 平台（首页当日招牌：enterprise-grade AI agent platform for customer support，「会执行退款/账户更新等真实动作」）：云托管现役线 + Hub 集成生态；GitHub 主仓是集成/开发工具面（MIT）， 产品本体闭源——「开源 Botpress」的说法要按仓内容拆开看。
entries.summaryEn: Botpress is an enterprise-oriented AI agent platform for customer support (same-day headline: "enterprise-grade AI agent platform for customer support", "takes real action on refunds/account updates"): hosted Cloud line + Hub integration ecosystem; the GitHub main repo is the integrations/devtools surface (MIT) while t

entries.summaryZh: Copilot Studio 是 Microsoft 生态里的企业低代码 agent 平台——它的「能不能用」很大程度取决于 你在不在 Power Platform/Dataverse 生态里。企业治理（身份、数据驻留）随 Microsoft 365 体系现成提供。
entries.summaryEn: Copilot Studio is Microsoft's enterprise low-code agent platform — whether it is usable largely depends on whether you are inside the Power Platform/Dataverse ecosystem. Enterprise governance (identity, data residency) comes ready-made with the Microsoft 365 system.

entries.summaryZh: 扣子（Coze）是字节的云托管 agent 搭建平台：国内版主打「模型自由切换 + 云手机/云电脑常驻 + 微信/抖音/飞书直达分发」， 国际版 coze.com 是同产品另一入口。没有自托管形态——数据与运行时都在云端。
entries.summaryEn: Coze is ByteDance's cloud-hosted agent-building platform: the domestic edition leads with “free model switching + always-on cloud phone/cloud PC + direct distribution via WeChat/Douyin/Feishu”; coze.com is the same product's other entry. There is no self-hosted form — data and runtime live in the cloud.

entries.summaryZh: Dify 是国产出海的 agentic 工作流平台：把提示词逻辑做成可见、可测、可交接的 Workflow/Chatflow 执行路径， 知识库管道与 Marketplace 集成是一等公民。许可是「Apache 2.0 + 两条附加条件」，多租户限制最该先读。
entries.summaryEn: Dify is the China-origin, globally-facing agentic workflow platform: prompt logic becomes visible, testable, handoff-ready Workflow/Chatflow execution paths, with knowledge pipelines and Marketplace integrations as first-class citizens. The license is “Apache 2.0 + two additional conditions” — the multi-tenant restrict

entries.summaryZh: FastGPT 是国产开源的 RAG 知识库问答与应用构建平台（文档主轴：知识库问答+agent/工作流编排）： 开源仓自托管（★29,949 当日核验）+ 官方托管双入口——fastgpt.io 国际版、fastgpt.cn 大陆版（页脚主体 广州环际云计算有限公司，ICP 备案在册）；许可是 Apache 2.0 加两条附加条件（与 Dify 同款）。
entries.summaryEn: FastGPT is a China-origin open-source RAG knowledge-base Q&A and app-building platform (docs' main axis: KB Q&A + agent/workflow orchestration): open-source repo self-hosted (★29,949 verified same day) + official hosted with two entries — fastgpt.io international, fastgpt.cn mainland (footer entity Guangzhou Huanji Clo

entries.summaryZh: Flowise 是「画布搭 LLM 应用」的开山一代（LangChain 组件族的可视化封装）：RAG/agent 流原型极快。 两个诚实标注：许可是 Apache 2.0 + enterprise 商业区混合；2026-08 后仓库推送放缓——热度与维护节奏要看快照。
entries.summaryEn: Flowise is the founding generation of “build LLM apps on a canvas” (a visual wrapper over LangChain components): RAG/agent-flow prototyping is extremely fast. Two honest notes: the license is Apache 2.0 + an enterprise commercial zone; repo pushes slowed after 2026-08 — momentum is a snapshot fact.

entries.summaryZh: Gumloop 是画布+连接器形态的企业向 AI agent 平台，多模型选择器是显性卖点（首页当日招牌：Build AI agents for work；Agent Settings 里 Model 可选「Smartest (Claude 5.5 Opus)」，用量面板按 GPT-6.1 Sol / Claude Opus 5.5 / Grok 4.7 / Kimi K3 / DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 归因 credits 消耗）：GTM/客服场景用例为主轴，法律主体是 AgentHub Inc.。
entries.summaryEn: Gumloop is a canvas+connectors enterprise AI agent platform with the multi-model picker as an explicit selling point (same-day homepage headline: Build AI agents for work; Agent Settings' Model item offers "Smartest (Claude 5.5 Opus)", the usage panel attributes credits across GPT-6.1 Sol / Claude Opus 5.5 / Grok 4.7 /

entries.summaryZh: 可视化/低代码搭 AI 工作流与 agent 的产品——交付物是「搭出来的应用/流程」，运行在平台的运行时上。给程序用的编排 SDK 归 framework；传统 RPA（无 LLM 主轴）归 nav。
entries.summaryEn: Visual / low-code platforms for building AI workflows and agents — the deliverable is the app or flow you assemble, running on the platform's runtime. SDKs for programmers go to frameworks; classic RPA without an LLM core goes to the nav site.

entries.summaryZh: Langflow 是 使用 MIT 许可的 LLM 画布平台，现归 DataStax—— 产品叙事向企业数据栈（AstraDB 向量线）倾斜。Python 自定义组件是它的扩展主轴。
entries.summaryEn: Langflow is an LLM canvas platform with a whole-repository MIT license, now under DataStax — the product narrative tilts toward the enterprise data stack (AstraDB vector line). Python custom components are its extension axis.

entries.summaryZh: Lindy 是「雇一个 AI 员工」形态的云端自动化平台（首页当日招牌：Hire an AI Employee That Gets Work Done—— Skills 40+ 内置、Memory 可编辑、Routines 定时跑、Watch and Learn 演示一次即接手）：邮件/日历/通话/CRM 场景为主轴， 1,500+ 集成 + MCP；不是画布也不是代码框架，是雇佣式 agent 产品。
entries.summaryEn: Lindy is a cloud automation platform packaged as "hiring an AI employee" (same-day homepage headline: Hire an AI Employee That Gets Work Done — 40+ built-in Skills, editable Memory, scheduled Routines, Watch and Learn: show it once and it takes over): email/calendar/call/CRM scenarios as the main axis, 1,500+ integrati

entries.summaryZh: Make（原 Integromat）是「流程图派」的可视化自动化平台——分支、迭代、路由器在画布上比表单派更直白； AI 是它众多模块之一，自动化才是身份。纯云托管，无自托管。
entries.summaryEn: Make (formerly Integromat) is the flowchart school of visual automation — branches, iterations and routers read more directly on the canvas than the form school; AI is one module among many, automation is the identity. Pure cloud hosting, no self-hosting.

entries.summaryZh: MaxKB 是飞致云出品的国产开源企业级智能体平台（官方博客当日口径：RAG 检索增强生成+工作流编排+技能 Skills+MCP 工具调用四能力）：GPL-3.0 开源自托管为主形态（★23,081 当日核验），深度合成服务算法备案双条目 在册（服务提供者+技术支持者，第十六批 2026-03-12）——企业内网「数据不出域」场景的国产合规叙事样本。
entries.summaryEn: MaxKB is Fit2Cloud's China-origin open-source enterprise agent platform (same-day official blog framing: four capabilities — RAG retrieval-augmented generation + workflow orchestration + Skills + MCP tool calling): GPL-3.0 open-source self-hosting is the main form (★23,081 verified same day), with two deep-synthesis al

entries.summaryZh: n8n 是「自动化优先」的低代码工作流平台——AI 是它众多节点里的一类，不是它的身份。 它最容易被误读的地方是许可：源码公开，但它是 fair-code（Sustainable Use License），不是 OSI 开源。
