entries.summaryEn: n8n is an automation-first low-code workflow platform — AI is one node type among many, not its identity. The most misread part is the license: source is public, but it is fair-code (Sustainable Use License), not OSI open source.

entries.summaryZh: Opal 是 Google Labs 的无代码 AI mini-app 搭建器：用自然语言描述，就能把生成、搜索、视频等步骤串成可分享的小应用。 实验服务计划于 2026-11-17 停用，现有工作流不会自动迁移。Drive 文件保留，提示与流程需按目标任务重新搭建。 跨大类对照：LangGraph。
entries.summaryEn: A no-code AI mini-app builder from Google Labs: natural-language steps chain generation, search and video into a shareable application. The experimental service is scheduled to turn off on 2026-11-17; workflows do not automatically migrate. Preserve prompts and Drive files and rebuild for the destination task.

entries.summaryZh: Pipedream 是「开发者向」的自动化平台：代码步骤（Node/Python/Bash）是一等公民，界面是搭流程的壳； Connect 线让「你的应用」成为别人工作流里的节点——被集成是它的商业主轴。
entries.summaryEn: Pipedream is the developer-facing automation platform: code steps (Node/Python/Bash) are first-class citizens, the UI is a flow-building shell; the Connect line makes *your app* a node inside other people's workflows — being integrated is its commercial axis.

entries.summaryZh: Relevance AI 主打「无代码搭 AI 员工团队」——多 agent 协作是它的叙事主轴，销售/运营自动化是主战场。 云托管、无自托管。
entries.summaryEn: Relevance AI leads with “build an AI workforce with no code” — multi-agent collaboration is its narrative axis, sales/operations automation is the main battlefield. Cloud-hosted, no self-hosting.

entries.summaryZh: SmythOS 现役真相面是 GitHub 上的开源 agent 运行时 SRE（仓描述当日在册：cloud-native runtime for agentic AI， local/cloud/edge 三态）：官网 smythos.com 已 302 重定向到 SRE 仓——早期「无代码 agent 平台+托管服务」的定位 不再自证；SRE/studio/docs 三仓推送停在 2026-04-03（未 archived），本站按 maintenance 口径写。
entries.summaryEn: SmythOS's current truth surface is the open-source agent runtime SRE on GitHub (repo description on record same day: cloud-native runtime for agentic AI, local/cloud/edge): smythos.com now 302-redirects to the SRE repo — the early "no-code agent platform + hosted service" positioning no longer self-attests; pushes acro

entries.zh: Vertex AI Agent Builder（Gemini Enterprise 平台线）
entries.summaryZh: Vertex AI Agent Builder 是 Google 的企业 agent 平台线——官方页已并入「Gemini platform」叙事 （enterprise-ready agents 的构建/部署/治理）。它与代码侧的 Google ADK 是同一战略的两条腿。
entries.summaryEn: Vertex AI Agent Builder is Google's enterprise agent platform line — the official page now sits under the “Gemini platform” narrative (build/deploy/govern enterprise-ready agents). It is the other leg of the same strategy as the code-side Google ADK.

entries.summaryZh: Voiceflow 是企业向客服/CX 场景的对话与语音 agent 画布平台（首页当日招牌：Enterprise Conversational AI Platform & Voice AI，「AI agents customers love. ROI you can prove」，3,000+ customers / 10K+ live agents）： 云托管、画布编排为主轴；早期「语音流原型工具」的旧印象已被现役企业 CX 定位覆盖。
entries.summaryEn: Voiceflow is an enterprise-oriented conversational & voice agent canvas platform for CX/support (same-day homepage headline: Enterprise Conversational AI Platform & Voice AI, "AI agents customers love. ROI you can prove", 3,000+ customers / 10K+ live agents): cloud-hosted, canvas orchestration as the main axis; the ear

entries.summaryZh: Zapier 是「连接器生态」的代名词——6000+ SaaS 集成的云托管自动化平台， 官方叙事已把 AI/agent（Canvas、Agents）提到主轴位置。没有自托管形态，一切在云端。
entries.summaryEn: Zapier is the synonym for the connector ecosystem — a cloud-hosted automation platform with 6000+ SaaS integrations, whose official narrative now puts AI/agents (Canvas, Agents) at the main axis. No self-hosted form; everything runs in the cloud.

entries.summaryZh: 智谱清言是「长文档解析 + 知识库检索」的国产对话产品：GLM 开源权重同族可选本地跑， 首批备案（2023-08-31）；产品名/模型名混用区，转述按官方页主语走。
entries.summaryEn: Zhipu Qingyan (ChatGLM) is the domestic chat product built on long-document parsing plus knowledge-base retrieval: GLM open weights make local runs a same-family option; first-batch filed (2023-08-31); product/model names overlap — relay per the official pages' subjects.

entries.summaryZh: OpenAI 的通用对话助手：网页/应用/桌面全端覆盖，模型家族按档位分流， 数据训练开关是它最常被误读的一行条款。
entries.summaryEn: OpenAI’s general-purpose chat assistant: web, apps and desktop fully covered, model family split by subscription tier — and the data-training toggle is its most commonly misread clause.

entries.summaryZh: 重长文与写作质量的通用对话应用：记忆做成可逐条编辑的清单， Cowork 线把「关机续跑、定时任务」写进了官方 release notes。
entries.summaryEn: A general chat app strong on long-form and writing quality: memory is an editable per-item list, and the Cowork line put “pause and resume after shutdown, scheduled tasks” into official release notes.

entries.summaryZh: DeepSeek 是「推理向问答 + 官方模型文档可回溯」的国产对话产品：云端对话与 API 文档同族， 开源权重线在站外可选；备案号经两家云厂商官方公示页交叉核验。
entries.summaryEn: DeepSeek is the domestic chat product built on reasoning-first Q&A with traceable official model docs: cloud chat and API docs share one family, open-weight models are selectable off-site; the filing number is cross-verified on two cloud vendors' official disclosure pages.

entries.summaryZh: 中文日常问答与文生图的国产主力：App 训练开关自助可关， 「App 默认可能训练、API 默认不训练」是两条线相反口径、最容易被混的一组条款。
entries.summaryEn: The domestic workhorse for everyday Chinese Q&A and text-to-image: the App training toggle is self-serve — “App may train by default, API doesn't train by default” is the opposite-direction pair of clauses most easily mixed up.

entries.summaryZh: Google 生态里的通用对话助手：网页/Windows/macOS 三端覆盖，模型按订阅档位分流， 「不训练你的邮箱原库，但训练回答过程里的摘要」是它最容易被误读的一行条款。
entries.summaryEn: The general chat assistant inside the Google ecosystem: web, Windows and macOS covered, models split by subscription tier — “it won't train on your raw Gmail/Drive, but it does train on summaries produced while answering” is its most easily misread clause.

entries.summaryZh: 接 X 实时信息的通用对话助手：搜索与公开帖子检索是核心差异点， 「未登录可能没有退出训练的选项」与「X 内是另一套条款」是两处必须先看边界。
entries.summaryEn: The general chat assistant wired into X's live information: search and public-post retrieval are the core differentiators — “logged-out users may get no training opt-out option” and “inside X a different set of terms applies” are the two boundaries to check first.

entries.summaryZh: 海螺AI 是 MiniMax 的多模态创作消费入口（对话在 /chat，官网主打视频/图片/音频创作线）： 自研 H 系列由产品侧路由不开放选模型，大陆直连可用，模型层已备案。
entries.summaryEn: Hailuo AI is MiniMax's consumer multimodal-creation entry (chat lives at /chat, the official site headlines the video/image/audio creation lines): the self-developed H series is routed by the product with no model picking, direct from the mainland works, and the model layer is filed.

entries.summaryZh: HuggingChat 是「只用开源模型」的聚合对话产品（HF 出品，当日 137 个模型+Omni 自动路由）： 前端 chat-ui 开源（Apache-2.0）可自部署——它同时是产品，也是开源 chat 前端的参考实现。
entries.summaryEn: HuggingChat is the "open-source models only" aggregator chat product (by Hugging Face, 137 models + Omni auto-routing on the day): the chat-ui frontend is open source (Apache-2.0) and self-deployable — it is both a product and the reference implementation of an open-source chat frontend.

entries.summaryZh: 通用 AI 对话助手——网页入口的多模型对话产品，国产与国际阵营都收。八维按消费级读法：背后模型是否披露、能不能选档、历史与记忆机制、账户数据用途与训练开关、产物商用条款。
entries.summaryEn: General AI chat assistants — multi-model web chat products, Chinese and international alike. The eight axes are read the consumer way: whether the model behind it is disclosed, whether you can pick tiers, how history and memory work, what your account data is used for, and what the terms say about commercial use.

entries.summaryZh: 中文长文档对话的主力：K3/K2.7 Code/K2.6/K2.5 模型家族官方产品线清晰， 「退出训练要走客服登记、账号级统一」是最需要提前确认的一条流程。
entries.summaryEn: The workhorse for long Chinese-document chat: the K3/K2.7 Code/K2.6/K2.5 model family is a clear official product line — “opting out of training goes through customer-service registration, at account level” is the process to confirm in advance.

entries.summaryZh: Le Chat 是 Mistral AI 的对话产品（chat.mistral.ai）：主轴是自家 Mistral 模型， 官方更新线把代码面（Vibe）与复杂任务（Work mode）写进 Le Chat 叙事；欧洲厂商，未备案。
entries.summaryEn: Le Chat is Mistral AI's chat product (chat.mistral.ai): the main axis is Mistral's own models, and the official update line writes the code surface (Vibe) and complex tasks (Work mode) into Le Chat's narrative; a European vendor, not filed.

entries.summaryZh: Manus 是「整段任务扔给云端沙箱」的通用任务 agent：云 VM 里执行代码/浏览/产出/发布（manus.space）， 模型由产品侧编排不开放选择；积分制，异步是本体形态。
entries.summaryEn: Manus is the general-task agent you hand whole tasks to in a cloud sandbox: code execution/browsing/output/publishing (manus.space) run in a cloud VM, models are orchestrated by the product with no user selection; credits-based, async is its core form.

entries.summaryZh: Meta AI 是 Meta 的对话助手（meta.ai + 嵌入 WhatsApp/IG/FB/Messenger）： Llama 系底座、免费+Meta 账号、图像生成在册；社交生态嵌入是它区别于其他对话产品的最大特征与最大权限面。
entries.summaryEn: Meta AI is Meta's chat assistant (meta.ai + embedded in WhatsApp/IG/Facebook/Messenger): Llama-family base, free with a Meta account, image generation on record; the social-ecosystem embedding is both its biggest difference from other chat products and its biggest permission surface.

entries.summaryZh: Microsoft Copilot 是 Windows/Edge/Bing 生态的免费对话入口：联网检索是底座能力， 模型由微软侧路由；与 Microsoft 365 Copilot、GitHub Copilot 是三个不同产品面，别混。
entries.summaryEn: Microsoft Copilot is the free chat entry of the Windows/Edge/Bing ecosystem: web search is the base capability, models are routed on Microsoft's side; it is three different products from Microsoft 365 Copilot and GitHub Copilot — don't mix them.

entries.summaryZh: Poe 是「一个账号用多家模型」的聚合对话产品（Quora 出品）：GPT/Claude/DeepSeek/Veo 等经 Poe 侧接入、 用户直接选模型，点数制计费，自建 bot 面在册；数据全部经 Poe 服务器中转。
entries.summaryEn: Poe is the "one account, many models" aggregator chat product (by Quora): GPT/Claude/DeepSeek/Veo etc. connect through Poe's side, users pick models directly, points-based billing, and a build-your-own-bot surface is on record; all data is relayed through Poe's servers.

entries.summaryZh: Reka Chat 是一家已整体转向 physical AI 的研究室留下的对话入口（app.reka.ai「Edge Chat」）： 公司当日招牌是 omni 模型、Reka Cloud、视频与数据基础设施；对话产品面薄，真正的可核验面在 API（OpenAI 兼容、自家 Edge/Flash+精选开源档）与 Reka Edge 开放权重本机路线。
entries.summaryEn: Reka Chat: a chat entry left behind by a lab that fully pivoted to physical AI — the homepage's marquee today is omni models, Reka Cloud, and video/data infrastructure; the chat surface (app.reka.ai "Edge Chat") is thin, and the verifiable surface is the API (OpenAI-compatible; in-house reka-edge-2603/reka-flash-3 + cu

entries.summaryZh: 阶跃AI 是阶跃星辰的国产对话产品（chat.stepfun.com，页内品牌「阶跃AI」）： 自研 Step 系列、开放权重线在 HF 同厂组织页联动，首批附近备案（2023-11-24），大陆直连可用。
entries.summaryEn: Step Chat is StepFun's domestic chat product (chat.stepfun.com, branded "Jieyue AI" in-page): self-developed Step series, with the open-weights line linked via the same vendor's Hugging Face org page, filed close to the first batch (2023-11-24), direct from the mainland works.

entries.summaryZh: 通义千问是阿里 Qwen 系的 C 端对话入口：多模态理解+文档解析，Qwen 开源权重同族可本地跑； 备案号经阿里云官方公示页核验。同厂商「千问/万相/百炼」三条线别混。
entries.summaryEn: Tongyi Qianwen is Alibaba's consumer entry to the Qwen family: multimodal understanding + document parsing, Qwen open weights runnable locally; the filing number is verified on Alibaba Cloud's official disclosure page. Don't mix the vendor's three lines — Qwen chat / Wanxiang image-video / Bailian API.

entries.summaryZh: 文心是百度生态里的对话入口（搜索/文库/网盘联动+联网检索）：文心系模型主线不开源权重， 首批备案（2023-08-31）；改名史「文心一言→文小言→文心」是检索时最容易踩的坑。
entries.summaryEn: Wenxin is Baidu's ecosystem chat entry (Search/Wenku/Netdisk integration + web search): the ERNIE line keeps weights closed, first-batch filed (2023-08-31); the rename history 'Wenxin Yiyan → Wenxiaoyan → Wenxin' is the easiest retrieval trap.

entries.summaryZh: 讯飞星火是语音底座突出的国产对话产品（讯飞自研星火系列，语音识别/合成/同传是传统强项）： 教育/办公场景友好，首批备案（2023-08-23）；星火主线不开源权重。
entries.summaryEn: iFlytek Spark is the domestic chat product with a strong voice foundation (iFlytek's self-developed Spark series; recognition/synthesis/interpretation are traditional strengths): education/office friendly, first-batch filed (2023-08-23); the Spark line does not open its weights.

entries.summaryZh: 腾讯元宝是泡在微信生态里的通用 AI 助手：搜公众号/视频号、评论区 @ 解读、联动腾讯文档与微信读书， 长文档精读是强项；模型主力是腾讯自研混元（Hy 系列）。
entries.summaryEn: Tencent Yuanbao is the general AI assistant living in the WeChat ecosystem: search official accounts/Channels, @-mention it in comment sections, integrate Tencent Docs and WeChat Read; long-document reading is its strong suit, powered by Tencent's self-developed Hunyuan (Hy) models.

entries.summaryZh: Aider 是一个终端 pair programming 工具。 它把 Git 集成当核心设计，不是附加功能。 AI 改动始终在版本控制里，可 diff 可撤销。
entries.summaryEn: A terminal pair-programming tool where Git integration is core design, not an add-on — AI changes always live in version control, diffable and revertible.

entries.summaryZh: 不是编辑器插件，是一种使用模式。 Aider 常驻 watch 你的文件，你在任意编辑器里加 AI 注释，它就响应。
entries.summaryEn: Not an editor plugin but a usage mode — Aider stays resident and watches your files; add an AI comment in any editor and it responds.

entries.summaryZh: Amazon Q Developer 是 AWS 的编码与运维助手（Bedrock 驱动）：IDE 插件做补全/生成/安全扫描/Java 升级， 问答面锚在你的 AWS 资源与架构——但官方已给 EOL：IDE 插件 2027-04-30 停止支持、CLI 已变 Kiro CLI， AWS 把 agentic 编码未来押在 Kiro 上。
entries.summaryEn: Amazon Q Developer is AWS's coding-and-operations assistant (powered by Bedrock): the IDE plugin does completions/generation/security scans/Java upgrades, and Q&A is grounded in your AWS resources and architecture — but AWS has published an EOL: IDE plugin support ends 2027-04-30 and the Q CLI has become the Kiro CLI;

entries.summaryZh: Amp 原是 Sourcegraph 出的前沿编码 agent，2025-12 官方公告分拆为独立公司 Amp Frontier Corporation （Sourcegraph 官方博客与 ampcode.com 公告同日互证）；CLI + 云端 orb + runner 三执行面。 发一句提示就能合上笔记本继续跑。 它多模型前沿路由，Oracle 提供「第二意见」模型。
entries.summaryEn: Amp is Sourcegraph's frontier coding agent, spanning CLI + cloud orbs + runners. Send a prompt and you can close your laptop while it keeps working. It routes across frontier models, with the Oracle as a second-opinion model.

entries.summaryZh: Augment Code 是企业级「软件工厂」平台：Cosmos 把规划-实现-评审-反馈连成可重复的 agent 流水线， Environments 可托管云/自有基础设施/本机三选一，Code Context Engine 招牌可经 MCP 插进别的 agent， 提供多厂商模型清单（含自研 Prism 路由）——2026-10-08 官方公告 Cosmos/Auggie CLI/Context Engine 资产加入 Harness。
entries.summaryEn: Augment Code is an enterprise 'software factory' platform: Cosmos chains plan-implement-review-feedback into repeatable agent loops, Environments run on Augment-hosted cloud, your own infrastructure (self-hosted daemons) or your laptop, the Code Context Engine plugs into other agents via MCP, and the model menu is amon

entries.summaryZh: 文心快码（Baidu Comate）是百度的 AI 编码全家桶：Comate AI IDE + VS Code/JetBrains/Visual Studio/Xcode 插件 + CLI，官方模型页以国产模型为主（DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi/MiniMax 可切、企业可加千帆）， Skills/Rules/Subagents/MCP/Memory/Automation 扩展面全成页，个人/企业/私有化三档—— 私有化「数据不出域」是它的官方合规主打。
entries.summaryEn: Baidu Comate (Wenxin Kuaima) is Baidu's AI coding family: a standalone Comate AI IDE + plugins for VS Code/JetBrains/Visual Studio/Xcode + CLI, with a model menu dominated by domestic LLMs (DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi/MiniMax switchable, enterprises can add Qianfan providers), a full extension stack (Skills/Rules/Subagents/MCP/M

entries.summaryZh: Bolt.new 是 StackBlitz 的浏览器内全栈 AI 构建器：跑在 WebContainers 上（浏览器里直接跑 Node.js， 免装环境），agent 分 Standard/Max 两档、按 token 计量，Bolt Cloud 给托管+数据库，GitHub 双向同步线在位。
entries.summaryEn: Bolt.new is StackBlitz's in-browser full-stack AI builder: it runs on WebContainers (Node.js directly in the browser, no local setup), the agent comes in Standard and Max tiers billed by tokens, Bolt Cloud adds hosting plus a database, and a GitHub sync line is in place.

entries.summaryZh: 提供终端编程与工具执行的产品，带 CHANGELOG 与 Atom feed；权限设置、执行边界与版本变化见下文。
entries.summaryEn: The highest data quality and most frequent releases in this track — it ships its own CHANGELOG and Atom feed, with the finest granularity in permission design.

entries.summaryZh: 一个进程、三种入口——终端、IDE、GitHub @claude 提及共用同一套权限与上下文机制。
entries.summaryEn: One process, three entry points — terminal, IDE and GitHub @claude mentions all share the same permission and context mechanism.

entries.summaryZh: 提供 CLI、桌面和编辑器入口的编码工具。CLI、Desktop App、VS Code 扩展共享同一开源核心。模型也是自选的。
entries.summaryEn: A coding tool with CLI, desktop and editor entry points — CLI, desktop app and VS Code extension share one open-source core, and the model is selectable.

entries.summaryZh: CodeBuddy 是腾讯云的三端编码助手（插件/AI IDE/CLI）：混元为主、可接其它大模型， Figma 到代码、CloudStudio 一键部署一条龙；所用混元模型备案号由官方文档公示。
entries.summaryEn: CodeBuddy is Tencent Cloud's three-surface coding assistant (plugin / AI IDE / CLI): Hunyuan as the anchor with other LLMs pluggable, Figma-to-code and one-click CloudStudio deploys; the Hunyuan model's filing number is published in the official docs.

entries.summaryZh: OpenAI 官方的终端编码 agent，Rust 实现，架构上强调 app server 与线程续接。
entries.summaryEn: OpenAI's official terminal coding agent, written in Rust, architecturally centred on the app server and thread resumption.

entries.summaryZh: Codex IDE 扩展是装进 VS Code / Cursor / Windsurf 的扩展，不是独立 IDE —— 它通过 app server 与 CLI 共享同一套会话机制。
entries.summaryEn: The Codex IDE extension is an extension you install into VS Code / Cursor / Windsurf, not a standalone IDE — it shares the same session mechanism with the CLI through the app server.

entries.summaryZh: 开源、模型完全自配的 IDE 扩展。 但它已停更：Continue 被 Cursor 收购，上游仓库转入 read-only， 官网只剩收购公告 —— 代码仍可自由使用，后续不会再有更新。
entries.summaryEn: An open-source IDE extension with fully self-configured models — VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin and a cn CLI over one agent core, with models configured freely in config.yaml. The official model-provider list spans Anthropic, Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, DeepSeek, Gemini, Mistral, Ollama (local models), OpenA

entries.summaryZh: Copilot 在终端里的编码 agent 形态，与 GitHub 订阅同源。 它能在终端里走完一条链。 "读仓库 / 改代码 / 跑测试 / 开 PR / 管 Issue" 都在终端里完成。 官方 README 说它 「Powered by the same agentic harness as GitHub's Copilot coding agent」 它与既有 GitHub Copilot（IDE 形态）是同一产品的两种装法。 本条目只写 CLI 的差异点： 程序化入口终端级审批按提示词扣 premium requests 的额度扣减方式
entries.summaryEn: GitHub Copilot CLI is the Copilot coding agent that runs in your terminal, carried by the same GitHub subscription as the IDE form factor. The official README says it is "Powered by the same agentic harness as GitHub's Copilot coding agent." Three things differ from the IDE form. It has a programmatic entry point (copi

entries.summaryZh: 与 GitHub 生态集成的编码工具——从网站到 CLI 到主流编辑器全覆盖，且能把任务委派给 Claude / Codex（Preview）。
entries.summaryEn: A coding tool integrated with the GitHub ecosystem — website, CLI and mainstream editors, and it can delegate tasks to Claude / Codex (Preview).

entries.summaryZh: crush 是 Charm 生态出品的 TUI 编码 agent，在终端里跑。 它的 列明 MCP 三种传输方式，并带一个官方订阅方案 Hyper。
entries.summaryEn: A TUI coding agent in the Charm ecosystem that runs in your terminal. Its MCP section describes three transport options, and it ships an official subscription plan, Hyper. Hyper is its own paid provider, so two cost models coexist. The license on GitHub is NOASSERTION, so commercial use is not something you can assume.

entries.summaryZh: Cursor 的终端形态：和编辑器共用同一账户、同一批模型、同一份 mcp.json。 命令名是 agent。 官方称它支持： 官方原文："print automation for scripts and CI pipelines" 也就是把 agent 写进脚本。 相对 IDE 形态，它多出两条路径。 一条是 headless 与非交互。 另一条是把会话交给 Cloud Agent 或持久会话。
entries.summaryEn: The terminal form of Cursor: it shares one account, one model catalogue and one mcp.json with the editor. The command is agent. Officially it supports "print automation for scripts and CI pipelines", so you can put the agent inside a script. Against the IDE form it adds two paths. One is headless non-interactive use. T

entries.summaryZh: 支持编辑器、云端 Agent 与自有机器执行。模型可得性、额度和数据边界随档位与部署方式变化，需分别核对。
entries.summaryEn: An editor with cloud-agent and self-hosted execution options. Check model availability, allowances and data boundaries for the actual tier and deployment.

entries.summaryZh: Devin 是「工单进、草稿 PR 出」的云异步软件工程师（Cognition）：会话在厂商云工作区跑， 自带 shell/IDE/浏览器，Slack/Linear/Jira 直接派单，并行处理积压任务。
entries.summaryEn: Devin is the 'ticket in, draft PR out' cloud async software engineer (Cognition): sessions run in the vendor's cloud workspace with its own shell/IDE/browser trio, dispatch work straight from Slack/Linear/Jira, and grind through backlogs in parallel.

entries.summaryZh: Droid 是 Factory AI 的终端编码 agent。 它模型无关——官方托管、BYOK、本地模型三路并存。 它以滚动 Rate Limits + 分级自主面向企业治理。
entries.summaryEn: Factory AI's terminal coding agent. Its pitch is model independence — the official BYOK page says "Use your own OpenAI or Anthropic keys, connect to any open source model providers, or run models locally", and your keys stay local: "Your API keys remain local and are not uploaded to Factory servers". Quota is not one m

entries.summaryZh: Google 官方的开源终端 agent，npx 免安装启动。 明确支持 MCP，另有非交互脚本模式。
entries.summaryEn: Google's official open-source terminal agent — npx, no install required. Explicit MCP support, plus a non-interactive script mode.

entries.summaryZh: Google Antigravity 是 Google 的 agent-first 开发平台：桌面指挥中心/CLI/IDE 扩展/Python SDK 四面共用一套 harness，命令执行策略与工作区边界是官方显式给的三档控制面。
entries.summaryEn: Google Antigravity is Google's agent-first development platform: desktop command center / CLI / IDE extensions / Python SDK — four surfaces on one harness, with command-execution policy and workspace boundaries as three explicit control switches in the official docs.

entries.summaryZh: 本地优先的开源通用 agent：桌面应用 + CLI + 可嵌入 API 三种形态都能跑。 由 Block 创建，现属 Agentic AI Foundation（Linux Foundation）。 provider 可换成 Ollama 等本地模型。 扩展面以 MCP extensions 为核心。
entries.summaryEn: A local-first, open-source general-purpose agent: it runs as a desktop app, a full CLI and an embeddable API. Created by Block and now hosted by the Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation). You can point it at Ollama or other local models, and its extension surface is built on MCP extensions. Stewardship note (checked

entries.summaryZh: 官方以具体岗位清单说明用途。 它不谈机制，直接列了九个岗位：销售线索、网站搭建、收件箱、会议代听……
entries.summaryEn: The official page explains uses through a list of jobs. It does not discuss mechanism — it just lists nine roles: sales leads, site building, inbox triage, meeting attendance and more.

entries.summaryZh: 自己能跑的成品 AI 编程工具，共用八维（模型接入 / 运行位置 / 本地文件 / 关机后任务 / 工具扩展 / 上下文 / 权限 / 适合场景）。按形态分三列——IDE 形态、CLI 形态、厂商云形态。前两者是同一产品的不同装法、不是竞争关系；厂商云形态则是另一个方向：不需要自己装，工作在别人的机器上做。
entries.summaryEn: Finished AI coding tools you can run yourself, compared on eight shared dimensions (model access / where it runs / local files / tasks after shutdown / tools and extensions / context / permissions / best fit). Grouped into three forms — IDE, CLI and vendor cloud. The first two are different install forms of the same pr

entries.summaryZh: 本机什么都不装，任务跑在 Google 的云机器上，做完给你一个 PR。 它和你熟悉的 IDE / CLI 助手最大的差别在交互：任务异步执行，不实时对话。 你提交任务、批准计划，然后走开，回头收 PR。 官方 GA 发布页原文："clones your codebase into a secure Google Cloud virtual machine (VM)"，以及 "operates asynchronously"。
entries.summaryEn: Google's asynchronous coding agent: point it at a GitHub repo, and it clones the code into a fresh cloud VM, plans the change, and opens a pull request for review. The difference from the IDE/CLI agents on this site is that the interaction is not live — you approve the plan and walk away. The official REST docs make th

entries.summaryZh: Junie 是 JetBrains 官方的 AI coding agent。 它的形态是插件加 CLI：插件装进 JetBrains IDE，CLI 跑在终端与 CI/CD 里。 三个招牌：先出计划再写代码、用真调试器排障、不锁模型。 Plan mode 产出结构化计划文档，确认后才实现。 排障时它接管调试会话、下断点，而不是加 println。 模型上支持 BYOK，也能接本地模型。
entries.summaryEn: Junie is JetBrains' coding agent, installed as a plugin — the official install page states "The Junie plugin is not bundled and not enabled in JetBrains IDEs by default" — and extended in March 2026 by a standalone Junie CLI for the terminal, any IDE, CI/CD and GitHub / GitLab. Its official framing is LLM-agnostic: "Ju

entries.summaryZh: Kilo Code 是开源编码 agent（GitHub MIT）：VS Code/JetBrains/CLI/Desktop + Cloud Agents 隔离容器，500+ 模型零加价、BYOK 与本地模型（Ollama/LM Studio）全支持，免费起步按供应商原价计量—— 官方叙事「all-in-one agentic engineering platform」，域名已迁 kilo.ai。
entries.summaryEn: Kilo Code is one of open-source coding agents (MIT on GitHub): VS Code/JetBrains/CLI/Desktop plus Cloud Agents in isolated containers, 500+ models at zero markup through the Kilo Gateway, full BYOK and local-model support (Ollama/LM Studio), free to start with usage billed at provider rates — the official narrative is

entries.summaryZh: AWS 出的 agentic 工程环境：一套 harness 同时撑起 IDE / CLI / Web / Mobile 四个端。 两个招牌： Spec 驱动 —— 先出 requirements / design / tasks 三段式，再写代码Cloud Session —— 关掉笔记本，任务还在云上跑
entries.summaryEn: Kiro is a desktop IDE — officially "a desktop development environment built on a VS Code foundation" — but it is framed as one agent, every surface: the IDE, CLI, Web and Mobile apps are all front ends to the same unified agent harness, connected over the open Agent Client Protocol (ACP). Its headline workflow is spec-

entries.summaryZh: Lovable 是瑞典 Lovable 的全栈 AI 建站平台：自然语言生成带前端/数据库/认证/托管的完整应用， 内置后端基于 Supabase 开源底座，Git 双向同步把代码放进你自己的仓库—— 官方口径「never locked in」，但构建模型不能指定、训练数据政策按计划分层。
entries.summaryEn: Lovable is Sweden's full-stack AI app builder: natural language in, a working app out with frontend, database, auth and hosting — the built-in backend runs on the Supabase open-source foundation, Git two-way sync puts code in your own repo, and the official line is 'never locked in'. But you cannot pick the build model

entries.summaryZh: 用独立 agent 承担审批的设计。Muse Secure VM 上跑着两个系统级隔离的东西：干活的 Muse，和否决它的 Sentinel。
entries.summaryEn: A design with a separate agent handling approval — two system-isolated things run on the Muse Secure VM: Muse doing the work, and Sentinel able to veto it.

entries.summaryZh: OpenAI 官方的云端编码 agent：本机什么都不装，所有工作发生在 OpenAI 的云端机器上。官方给的能力边界写得很直白： 独立云端电脑自带浏览器插件接 4,000 多款应用关机后仍在推进工作
entries.summaryEn: Nothing installs locally; all work happens on OpenAI's cloud machine — the stated capability boundary is blunt: a standalone cloud computer plus its own browser plus plugins into 4,000+ apps, and it keeps progressing after you shut down.

entries.summaryZh: MIT 许可的多 provider 编程 harness。它运行 bash 命令前会询问权限，并支持 ACP 载入。
entries.summaryEn: An MIT-licensed multi-provider programming harness that asks permission before running bash commands, and supports loading via ACP.

entries.summaryZh: Qoder CN 是阿里云的 AI 编码产品线（原通义灵码，2026-05-20 官方更名）：桌面 IDE + JetBrains 插件 + CLI 三形态，国内主流大模型可切换可 BYOK，记忆/Repo Wiki/知识库三层上下文，全家桶 Credits 共享—— 「阿里云一方产品 + 国内部署」是它的官方合规叙事。
entries.summaryEn: Qoder CN is Alibaba Cloud's AI coding product line (formerly Lingma, officially renamed 2026-05-20): desktop IDE + JetBrains plugin + CLI, switchable mainstream domestic models or BYOK, three context layers (memory / Repo Wiki / knowledge base), Credits shared across the family — 'first-party Alibaba Cloud product + do

entries.summaryZh: Qoder 是阿里体系的 AI 编码产品国际线（qoder.com，与国内线 Qoder CN/原通义灵码分线）： Qoder IDE + JetBrains 插件 + CLI + Cloud Agents 全托管云沙箱一个家族，档位/指定模型可切、可 BYOK， Repo Wiki + 记忆 + Skills 上下文体系，Experts Mode 多专家并行——官方叙事是「agentic platform for real work」。
entries.summaryEn: Qoder is the Alibaba-affiliated international line of the Qoder coding family (qoder.com, separate from domestic Qoder CN / formerly Lingma): Qoder IDE + JetBrains plugin + CLI + fully managed Cloud Agents under one family, tier or named-model selection with BYOK, Repo Wiki + memory + Skills context stack, Experts Mode

entries.summaryZh: Replit Agent 是「从自然语言到能上线的应用」的云 IDE agent：建项目、装基础设施、测试、部署一条龙， Free/Power/Max 模式选档不选裸模型，checkpoint 兜底回滚。
entries.summaryEn: Replit Agent is the cloud-IDE agent from plain language to a deployable app: it builds the project, sets up infrastructure, tests, and deploys in one chain; Free/Power/Max modes pick tiers rather than bare models, with checkpoints as the rollback safety net.

entries.summaryZh: Trae 是字节跳动的三端 AI IDE（桌面/Web/移动）：Desktop 双窗口（Agent/IDE）+ SOLO 模式整段委托， 内置多模型可加自定义 key，Privacy mode 与沙箱执行是官方显式给的开关。
entries.summaryEn: Trae is ByteDance's three-client AI IDE (desktop / web / mobile): dual windows on desktop (Agent/IDE) with SOLO mode for whole-task delegation, built-in multi-model plus custom keys, Privacy mode and sandboxed execution as official switches.

entries.summaryZh: v0 是 Vercel 的提示词到全栈应用平台：聊天生成 Next.js 应用，VM 沙箱内跑真终端与预装 agent （claude 可直接用），GitHub 同步进你的仓库，publish 走 Vercel 部署链——权限三档 Ask/Auto/Full， 自定义模型是 Enterprise 面。
entries.summaryEn: v0 is Vercel's prompt-to-full-stack platform: chats generate Next.js apps, a VM sandbox runs a real terminal with pre-installed agents (claude is ready to use), GitHub sync moves code into your repo, and publishing runs through the Vercel deployment chain — Ask/Auto/Full permission tiers, custom models are Enterprise-s

entries.summaryZh: 开源的终端 agent 环境。 官方自称： 「Agentic Development Environment」 它把现代终端、编码 agent、Warp Drive 协作与云 agent / Factories 合成一个产品。
entries.summaryEn: Warp is an open-source Agentic Development Environment — the vendor's own wording, verbatim. The same Warp Agent is reachable three ways: "In the Warp app", "In any terminal, with the Warp Agent CLI", and "In the cloud, as a cloud agent". Account, rules, skills and model access are shared across all three. The CLI is "

entries.summaryZh: 已改称 Devin Desktop（被 Cognition 收购后）——有自研模型 SWE-2、支持 ACP preview、有过 Restricted Mode 的 CVE 修复记录。
entries.summaryEn: Now renamed Devin Desktop (after the Cognition acquisition) — it has its own SWE-2 model, supports ACP preview, and has a CVE fix history involving Restricted Mode.

entries.summaryZh: Zed 在一个编辑器里编排三种 agent 路径：Zed 原生 Agent，Claude / Codex，OpenCode / Copilot / Cursor。
entries.summaryEn: Not "yet another AI coding tool" but an orchestration layer for three agent paths — use Zed's native agent in the same editor, or attach Claude / Codex / OpenCode / Copilot / Cursor.

entries.summaryZh: AG2 是 AutoGen 停更后由社区接棒的续作。 仓库描述直接写着 "AG2 (formerly AutoGen)"。 README 也自述维护方： "a dynamic group of volunteers from several organizations" 理解它必须先分清两条线： AG2（本条目）Microsoft Agent Framework维护方社区（ag2ai）微软官方与 AutoGen 关系社区延续 / fork 后的独立演进官方把 AutoGen + Semantic Kernel 合并继任顶层 importimport ag2agent_framework / Microsoft.Agents.AI 这
entries.summaryEn: AG2 is an open-source Python framework for building AI agents and coordinating multiple agents to solve tasks, with "agents capable of interacting with each other," broad LLM support, tooling, autonomous and human-in-the-loop workflows, and multi-agent conversation patterns. It is the community continuation of AutoGen:

entries.summaryZh: AgentScope 是国产多智能体框架的主力线（Apache-2.0，阿里/魔搭系）：Msg 消息传递抽象清晰， 带可视化工作台与分布式执行线。33k★、活跃维护。L5 口径：能力描述全部转述官方文档。
entries.summaryEn: AgentScope is the flagship domestic multi-agent framework (Apache-2.0, Alibaba/ModelScope line): a clean Msg message-passing abstraction, with a visual Studio workbench and distributed-execution lines. 33k stars, actively maintained. Per rule L5: all capability descriptions paraphrase official docs.

entries.summaryZh: Agno（原 Phidata）把「框架 + 控制平面」做成一体（Apache-2.0）：库侧定义 agent/team/workflow， AgentOS 控制平面侧跑起来、观测、调度（「self-driving agent platform」）。发版高频 （v3.1.12，2026-10-29）、changelog 当日有条目——活跃线。
entries.summaryEn: Agno (formerly Phidata) ships framework + control plane as one: define agents/teams/workflows in code, AgentOS runs, observes and schedules them ("self-driving agent platform"). Frequent releases (v3.1.12, 2026-10-29) — an active line.

entries.summaryZh: 它是什么：Claude Code 的编程接口（Python 版）。 它把一个成熟的 coding CLI 变成 Python 能驱动的对象。 它不是一个自建 agent 的框架。 模型接入受该产品官方接口限制 —— 后面所有取舍都由这条决定。 官方 README 首行："Python SDK for Claude Agent."
entries.summaryEn: What it is: the Python programming interface to Claude Code. It turns a polished coding CLI into an object you can drive from Python. It is not a framework for building your own agent. It is also the only coding base among our ten objects that cannot switch models — every trade-off below follows from that. Official REA

entries.summaryZh: 「把 Codex CLI 变成 Node 进程里可驱动的对象」。官方 README 首句就是 「Embed the Codex agent in your workflows and apps」，第二句划清了形态： The TypeScript SDK wraps the codex CLI from @openai/codex. It spawns the CLI and exchanges JSONL events over stdin/stdout.
entries.summaryEn: "Turns the Codex CLI into an object you can drive inside a Node process" — the official README opens with "Embed the Codex agent in your workflows and apps"; the second sentence settles the form: The TypeScript SDK wraps the codex CLI from @openai/codex. It spawns the CLI and exchanges JSONL events over stdin/stdout.

entries.summaryZh: CrewAI 是一个 Python 框架。它用「角色分工」和「业务流程」两套比喻来编排多 agent。 官方自述是 "Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents." 「role-playing」这个词容易让人低估它。 同一份 README 里也写着 production-grade， 并明确承诺： "Move from experiment to production without changing frameworks."
entries.summaryEn: CrewAI is a Python framework that orchestrates multi-agent work through two metaphors: role division and business process. The official description reads: "Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents." The word "role-playing" makes people underrate it. The same README also says production-grade, and

entries.summaryZh: Deep Agents 是 LangChain 出的通用 agent harness。 它把 filesystem、子代理、上下文管理、skills 都预置好了。 开箱即跑。 官方自述： 官方原文： "batteries-included agent harness" 它的设计目标是长任务、多步流程。凡是预置的那一层，都不改代码就能替换。
entries.summaryEn: Deep Agents is a general-purpose agent harness from LangChain. It ships with filesystem, sub-agents, context management and skills already in place, so it runs out of the box. The official description is "batteries-included agent harness". It is built for long, multi-step tasks, and anything in that pre-bundled layer c

entries.summaryZh: DSPy 把「调提示词」变成编程问题（MIT，Stanford NLP/Databricks）：签名声明输入输出， 优化器把提示当参数训练。用它的分水岭一句话：有没有评估指标——有指标它是杠杆，没指标它无从下手。
entries.summaryEn: DSPy turns 'tuning prompts' into a programming problem (MIT, Stanford NLP/Databricks): signatures declare inputs/outputs, optimizers train prompts as parameters. The dividing line in one sentence: do you have an evaluation metric — with one it is a lever, without one it has nothing to optimize.

entries.summaryZh: ElizaOS 把「角色」做成 agent 单元（MIT，TypeScript）：一个 character 配置文件定义人格与能力， 常驻进程接多渠道（官方仓自称「agentic operating system」）。加密社区出身、插件生态大—— 框架面与投机叙事要分开看。
entries.summaryEn: ElizaOS makes the "character" the agent unit: one config file defines persona + capabilities, a resident process connects channels. Crypto-community origins and a big plugin ecosystem — keep the framework separate from the speculation narrative.

entries.summaryZh: 一句话说清它是什么： Google ADK 是「code-first 的 agent 编排框架，核心资产是一个图执行引擎」。 它的作用是把多个 agent 组织成一条流程，不替你跑单个 agent。 官方 README 的第一项特性就说明了它的身份： Workflow Runtime: A graph-based execution engine for composing deterministic execution flows for agentic apps, with support for routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, retry, state management, dynamic n
entries.summaryEn: What it is, in one line: Google ADK is a "code-first agent orchestration framework whose core asset is a graph execution engine". It organises several agents into one flow; it does not run a single agent for you. The official README states its identity in the first feature it lists: Workflow Runtime: A graph-based exec

entries.summaryZh: Haystack 是「检索质量工程」那一派的 RAG 框架（Apache-2.0，deepset）：索引/查询管线分离、 hybrid 检索与 reranker、评估环——生产味最浓的一条 RAG 线。2.x 管线 API 大改，旧教程要警惕。
entries.summaryEn: Haystack is the RAG framework of the 'retrieval-quality engineering' school (Apache-2.0, deepset): separated indexing/query pipelines, hybrid retrieval with rerankers, an evaluation loop — the most production-flavored RAG line. The 2.x pipeline API was rewritten; beware old tutorials.

entries.summaryZh: Hermes Agent 是一个常驻的跨平台个人助手，会从经验里自己攒技能。 它不绑在你的笔记本上。 官方 README 说： The self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research. It's the only agent with a built-in learning loop — it creates skills from experience, improves them during use, nudges itself to persist knowledge, searches its own past conversations, and builds a deepe
entries.summaryEn: Hermes Agent is a resident cross-platform personal assistant that accumulates its own skills from experience. It is not tied to your laptop — the official README says: The self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research. It's the only agent with a built-in learning loop — it creates skills from experience, improves them

entries.summaryZh: Agent 运行时 / 编排框架 / SDK 的责任边界、状态持久化能力与权限模型。收录标准：提供 Agent 运行时或编排层、有官方文档可回溯、近 30 天有实质更新。
entries.summaryEn: The responsibility boundaries of agent runtimes, orchestration frameworks and SDKs, plus state persistence and permission models. Admission criteria: provides an agent runtime or orchestration layer, has official documentation that can be traced back, and has substantive updates within the last 30 days.

entries.summaryZh: LangChain 是 LLM 应用框架生态的主体（MIT，148k★）：模型/工具/检索的统一抽象层， 提供多类集成入口。同厂商三条线要分清：LangChain（组件抽象）、LangGraph（图编排）、Deep Agents（预制深 agent）。
entries.summaryEn: LangChain is the main body of the LLM-app framework ecosystem (MIT, 148k stars): a unified abstraction layer for models/tools/retrieval with multiple integration entry points. Three lines from the same vendor to keep apart: LangChain (component abstraction), LangGraph (graph orchestration), Deep Agents (prebuilt deep a

entries.summaryZh: LangChain4j 是 Java 生态的 LLM 应用框架：统一模型与向量库接口，支持工具调用与 MCP， 可嵌进 Quarkus、Spring Boot、Helidon 服务。 跨大类对照：vLLM。
entries.summaryEn: A Java LLM application framework: unified model and vector-store interfaces, tool calling and MCP, embeddable in Quarkus, Spring Boot or Helidon services.

entries.summaryZh: LangGraph 是一个低层编排框架，专门用来构建有状态的 agent。 官方自述很克制，注意那个 low-level： Low-level orchestration framework for building stateful agents. 它自认不是开箱即用的高层封装。 它打的是「长时间运行、有状态」这件事的地基。
entries.summaryEn: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building stateful agents. The official description is deliberately modest — note that word, low-level: Low-level orchestration framework for building stateful agents. It does not claim to be a batteries-included high-level wrapper. It lays the groundwork for long-run

entries.summaryZh: Letta（原 MemGPT）把 agent 做成持久实体（Apache-2.0）：agent 服务器常驻、记忆分层 （core 自编辑 + archival 检索）、会话可中断续接。形态是它与其它框架最大的差异—— 它是服务器，不是库。
entries.summaryEn: Letta (formerly MemGPT) makes agents persistent entities (Apache-2.0): a resident agent server, layered memory (self-edited core + retrieval-backed archival), sessions that interrupt and resume. Form is its biggest difference from other frameworks — it is a server, not a library.

entries.summaryZh: 一句话说清：LlamaIndex 是一个 Python 库。它把外部数据接进来做检索问答。 ⚠ 但有件事必须先说。 官方已明确把公司重心从「编排框架」移走： The current focus of LlamaIndex is to build the best AI-powered engine for document parsing and extraction. LlamaParse is our enterprise platform for agentic OCR, parsing, extraction, indexing and more. ...the company itself has undergone an
entries.summaryEn: In one sentence: LlamaIndex is a Python library. It pulls external data in for retrieval and question answering. ⚠ But one thing has to be said first. The project has explicitly moved its company focus away from "orchestration frameworks": The current focus of LlamaIndex is to build the best AI-powered engine for docum

entries.summaryZh: Mastra 是「TypeScript 生态的全栈式 agent 框架」。 装一个包，Agents、图工作流、Memory、RAG、Evals、MCP、内置 server 与 Studio 就都在里面。 官方自述很直白： Mastra is a framework for building AI-powered applications and agents with a modern TypeScript stack. It includes everything you need to go from early prototypes to production-ready applications. 关键词是 everythi
entries.summaryEn: Mastra is a TypeScript framework for building AI agents and applications - official README: "Mastra is a framework for building AI-powered applications and agents with a modern TypeScript stack. It includes everything you need to go from early prototypes to production-ready applications." One package covers Agents, gra

entries.summaryZh: MetaGPT 把「软件公司」写进多 agent 协作（MIT）：产品经理→架构师→工程师→QA 的角色流水线， SOP 编码进 agent 交互。学术热度大（71,097★）；但仓侧主线推送停在 2026-01、release 停在 2025-03—— 团队重心在组织内其他项目上移，生产选型按仓侧现状判断。
entries.summaryEn: MetaGPT writes a "software company" into multi-agent collaboration (PM → architect → engineer → QA, SOPs encoded into role interactions). Huge paper heat (71,097 stars); but repo pushes stopped at 2026-01 and releases at 2025-03 — judge production selections by repo-side facts.

entries.summaryZh: 它是什么：「Semantic Kernel 与 AutoGen 合并后的微软官方 agent 底座」。 全名 Microsoft Agent Framework（本站下称 MAF）。 官方公告页把这层血缘关系写得最清楚： Microsoft Agent Framework doesn't replace Semantic Kernel and AutoGen — it builds on them. 官方 overview 页同样直白（原文）： "It brings together and extends ideas from Semantic Kernel and AutoGen projects... Built by the
entries.summaryEn: What it is: "the Microsoft-official agent foundation that merged Semantic Kernel and AutoGen". Full name Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF below). The official announcement page puts the lineage most plainly — "Microsoft Agent Framework doesn't replace Semantic Kernel and AutoGen — it builds on them" — and the official ov

entries.summaryZh: Open Interpreter 把「开放模型 + 本地终端执行」做成产品（Apache-2.0）： 一个跑在你终端里的编码 agent，代码与命令直接落在你的机器上执行；当前走 Rust 重写线 （releases rust-v*），主打 Kimi K3/GLM 5.3 这类开放权重模型。
entries.summaryEn: Open Interpreter pairs open models with local execution: a coding agent in your terminal, code and commands running on your own machine; the current line is a Rust rewrite (rust-v* releases), leading with open-weight models like Kimi K3 / GLM 5.3.

entries.summaryZh: OpenAI Agents SDK 是「primitives-only 的多agent harness」。 官方自述 lightweight yet powerful：filesystem / 规划 / 记忆都不替你决定。
entries.summaryEn: "A primitives-only multi-agent harness" — the official description is "lightweight yet powerful": it hands you the agent-loop primitives and does not decide for you how the filesystem, planning or memory work.

entries.summaryZh: 它是个自托管的 agent 控制中心。官方 README 现在管它叫 Agent Canvas。 它带的是一整套栈：Web GUI、Terminal UI、CLI、REST API 都在里面。 它管的 agent 不止自家那一个。Codex、Claude Code、Gemini 都能挂上去跑。 官方定位原文：The self-hosted developer control center for coding agents and automations. Run OpenHands, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or any ACP-compatible agent across local, remo
entries.summaryEn: It is a self-hosted control centre for agents — the official README now calls it Agent Canvas. It ships as a whole stack: a web GUI, a terminal UI, a CLI and a REST API all live in it. And it drives more than its own agent — Codex, Claude Code and Gemini can all run on top of it. Official positioning: The self-hosted d

entries.summaryZh: Pydantic AI 是 Pydantic 出的 Python agent 库。 主打类型安全。官方自述把两个关键词并在一起 —— Pydantic AI is the Python AI SDK: a typed, extensible agent loop with every model a string swap away. 「typed」是它的世界观：Pydantic 原生贯穿数据层到 agent 输出。 「agent loop」是它的形态：给原语，不给你一个成品。 它与 OpenAI Agents SDK 同属这一档。 但它把「类型安全」和「durable execution」两点做到明显更深。
entries.summaryEn: Pydantic AI is the Python agent library from Pydantic. Its selling point is type safety. The official self-description puts two keywords together: "Pydantic AI is the Python AI SDK: a typed, extensible agent loop with every model a string swap away." "Typed" is its worldview: Pydantic runs natively from the data layer

entries.summaryZh: Semantic Kernel 是微软的企业级 AI 嵌入 SDK（MIT，C#/.NET + Python 双线）： connector 接模型、skills/plugins 挂函数，把 LLM 嵌进现有应用进程。1.x 线仍在发版 （python-1.46.0，2026-10-28）；但官方已指明 Microsoft Agent Framework 为其指定后继—— 现役维护与新投资重心是两条线。
entries.summaryEn: Semantic Kernel is Microsoft's enterprise AI-embedding SDK (MIT, C#/.NET + Python both releasing): connectors for models, skills/plugins for functions. The 1.x line still ships — but the official docs name Microsoft Agent Framework as its designated successor.

entries.summaryZh: smolagents 是一个薄 agent 库 —— 它让 agent「用代码思考」。 官方自述是 "barebones library for agents that think in code"（仓库 description 原文）。 它最核心的设计是 code-as-action。默认的 CodeAgent 让 LLM 把动作写成 Python 代码， 并执行它。它不输出 JSON 工具调用。
entries.summaryEn: A thin agent library from Hugging Face — the repository description is literal: "barebones library for agents that think in code". The core difference is code-as-action. The default CodeAgent lets the LLM write its actions as Python code and execute them, instead of emitting JSON tool calls. The official claim is that

entries.summaryZh: Spring AI 把 AI 能力做成 Spring 组件：可移植 Model API、ChatClient、向量库与 MCP 集成， 用 Spring Boot 的 starter 和 auto-configuration 装配。 跨大类对照：vLLM。
entries.summaryEn: AI as Spring components: a portable Model API, ChatClient, vector stores and MCP integration, assembled with Spring Boot starters and auto-configuration.

entries.summaryZh: AWS 的开源 agent SDK（Apache-2.0）：model-driven 循环、装饰器式工具、MCP 客户端是官方主线。 与 Bedrock Agents 托管线分清楚：Strands 是「拿来自己搭的底座」（本大类），托管线在 automation。 仓现名 harness-sdk（旧名 redirect——直抓核验）。
entries.summaryEn: AWS's open-source agent SDK (Apache-2.0): model-driven loops, decorator-style tools, MCP client support on the official mainline. Keep it apart from the hosted Bedrock Agents line: Strands is a build-it-yourself foundation (this category); the hosted line lives in automation. The repo is now harness-sdk (old name redir

entries.summaryZh: SWE-agent 是「agent 修代码」研究线的参考实现（MIT，Princeton/Stanford）： ACI（为 agent 设计的计算机界面）是它的核心命题，与 SWE-bench 评测生态同源。 生产开箱不是它的定位——它是给研究与评测用的参考实现。
entries.summaryEn: SWE-agent is a research harness for agent-driven code repair (MIT, Princeton/Stanford): ACI (agent-computer interface) is its core thesis, co-origin with the SWE-bench evaluation ecosystem. Production out-of-the-box is not its positioning — it is a reference implementation for research and evaluation.

entries.summaryZh: AI SDK 7 是 TypeScript/JS 的 agent 应用工具箱：统一的模型调用、工具调用与流式输出， 新增 HarnessAgent 后还能把 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等既有 agent 运行时当成可切换后端。 跨大类对照：Cursor。
entries.summaryEn: A TypeScript/JS agent toolkit: unified model and tool calls plus streaming, and with HarnessAgent it can treat Claude Code, Codex, Pi and other runtimes as switchable backends.

entries.summaryZh: Adobe Firefly 是面向企业的图像生成线：授权内容训练+输出赔偿是它的采购卖点， 嵌 Adobe 生态（独立线+CC 内嵌两入口）；不开源。
entries.summaryEn: Adobe Firefly is the enterprise-grade design AI line (standalone product, not the generation-fill inside Photoshop): licensed-training + enterprise indemnification narrative; third-party models selectable inside the app per official positioning.

entries.summaryZh: Clipdrop 是「单图原子操作」的图像编辑工具集：抠图/去物/重打光（招牌 Relight）/放大/扩图各成一工具； 归属三跳（InitML→Stability→Jasper），API 现在走 Jasper 口径。
entries.summaryEn: Clipdrop is the single-image atomic-operation toolkit: cutout/cleanup/relight (its signature)/upscale/uncrop each as a standalone tool; ownership moved three times (InitML→Stability→Jasper, Feb 2024) — API terms now run on Jasper's side.

entries.summaryZh: 图像模型家族的双路线供应商：官方 API/playground 托管生成，部分权重开源可自托管甚至进端侧； 「不主张所有权、但禁训练其他模型」是条款里需要单独核对的条款。
entries.summaryEn: The dual-route supplier of the FLUX model family: hosted generation via the official API/playground, some weights open for self-hosting and even on-device; “claims no ownership, but bans training other models” is the sharpest cut in the terms.

entries.summaryZh: Ideogram 以「图内排版文字」见长：4.0 开放量化权重（非商用免费/商用自托管需许可）， 4.5 闭源托管主打 precise edit；官方 MCP server 可直接接进 agent 工作流。
entries.summaryEn: Ideogram is the typography-first image generator (text rendering inside images is its signature): 4.0 released open quantized weights (free but non-commercial), 4.5 is closed; direct access from the mainland measures 000.

entries.summaryZh: 图像生成产品：文生图、编辑工作台、聚合模型入口。八维按消费级读法；permissions 维必答产物商用授权与训练用途——「能生成」≠「能商用」。
entries.summaryEn: Image-generation products: text-to-image, editing workbenches, aggregated-model front ends. The eight axes are read the consumer way; the permissions axis must answer commercial use and training consent — "you can generate it" is not "you can sell it".

entries.summaryZh: 即梦是字节剪映系的「中文出图 + 视频」C 端入口（Seedream 图片 / Seedance 视频）： 抖音生态发布链路是差异点；水印与会员档位绑定，ICP 备案≠生成式 AI 服务备案（后者未核验到）。
entries.summaryEn: Jimeng is ByteDance's dedicated image/video creation console (Seedream/Seedance model lines, built by the Jianying team): text-to-image, image-to-video and digital-human lines in one console; the generative-AI service filing number was not found (only an ICP number verified) — filing: unknown is an honest gap, not a ve

entries.summaryZh: Krea 是「实时生成 + 多模型聚合」的创作台：边画边出的实时线是招牌，官网聚合 64+ 家模型 （Veo/Ideogram/Flux 等）+ 自研 Krea 2 线；「Do not train」是官方营销口径。
entries.summaryEn: Krea is the real-time + multi-model aggregation console: draw-as-you-see realtime line is the signature, 64+ third-party models aggregated (Veo/Ideogram/Flux…) plus self-developed Krea 2; 'Do not train' is marketing copy, terms govern.

entries.summaryZh: Leonardo 是游戏资产向的图像创作台：自研 Phoenix/Lucid 线 + Element 小样本训练做风格一致性 + model hub 聚合选模型；2024-07 起归 Canva 旗下。
entries.summaryEn: Leonardo is the game-asset-oriented image console: self-developed Phoenix/Lucid lines + Element few-shot training for style/character consistency + a model hub; under Canva since July 2024.

entries.summaryZh: Microsoft Designer 是微软生态的免费 AI 设计入口（模板+生成一体，模型由微软路由）： 与 Copilot 图像线同生态不同入口；商用权随订阅档位变化。
entries.summaryEn: Microsoft Designer is the free design entry of the Microsoft ecosystem (templates + generation): models routed on Microsoft's side; same ecosystem as Copilot's image line but a different entry; commercial rights vary by subscription tier.

entries.summaryZh: 图像生成平台：网页 + Discord 双线，社区默认公开可 Remix； 「付费拥有 Assets、但大营收公司要高档位」是最容易被忽略的一条许可门槛。
entries.summaryEn: An image-generation platform: web + Discord dual line, community output public and Remixable by default; “paid users own the Assets, but high-revenue companies need a higher tier” is the licensing threshold most overlooked.

entries.summaryZh: Playground 是「设计成品」向的 AI 设计台：模板+Smart Layers 图层编辑把点子变成贴纸/T 恤/海报/logo， 生图用第三方模型（GPT Image 2/Nano Banana/Seedream）；自研模型时代已结束，公司 2026-06 售出后由新团队运营。
entries.summaryEn: Playground is an AI design bench aimed at finished designs: templates + Smart Layers editing turn ideas into stickers, T-shirts, posters and logos, with third-party models (GPT Image 2 / Nano Banana / Seedream) doing the generation; the in-house model era is over, and since the June 2026 sale a new team runs it.

entries.summaryZh: Recraft 是设计向图像台里罕见的「矢量原生」：真 SVG 输出、brand kit 品牌一致性、图内文字精确定位； 免费档作品公开且不可商用是它最关键的档位硬线。
entries.summaryEn: Recraft is the rare vector-native design console: true SVG output, brand-kit consistency, precise in-image text placement; free-plan works are public and not licensed for commercial use — the plan-level hard line.

entries.summaryZh: SeaArt 是二次元/插画向的社区型聚合创作台：云端 LoRA 训练+导出、社区模型库（许可逐模型标注）、 多家第三方模型聚合；中国团队（成都海艺互娱）的出海产品。
entries.summaryEn: SeaArt is the community-type anime/illustration aggregation console: cloud LoRA training with ComfyUI export, a community model library whose licenses are labeled per model, multi-vendor model aggregation; a going-overseas product by Chengdu-based Haiyi.

entries.summaryZh: 「平台 + 开源权重」双路线的图像厂商：平台输出所有权转让给用户， 训练退出写在条款里；开源线自托管商用要逐模型看许可证。
entries.summaryEn: The image vendor on the “platform + open weights” dual route: the platform assigns output ownership to users and the training opt-out is written into the terms; self-hosting the open-weights line commercially requires checking each model's license.

entries.summaryZh: Tensor.Art 是 SD 生态的社区模型托管+在线生成台：checkpoint/LoRA 上传分享与在线跑、在线 LoRA 训练、 免费 credit+VIP 订阅；主体是隐私页在册的香港公司（ECHO INTERNATIONAL HK LIMITED）。
entries.summaryEn: Tensor.Art is the SD-ecosystem community model hosting + online generation bench: checkpoint/LoRA upload, sharing and online runs, online LoRA training, free credits + VIP subscription; the entity on record in the privacy policy is a Hong Kong company (ECHO INTERNATIONAL HK LIMITED).

entries.summaryZh: 通义万相是「云端产品 + Apache-2.0 开源权重」双轨的国产图视频创作台（Wan 系列）： 合规敏感场景可本地跑，备案号经阿里云官方公示核验；产品端与开源线数据边界完全不同。
entries.summaryEn: Tongyi Wanxiang is Alibaba's image/video creation console with an open-weights twin: the Wan weight family is Apache-2.0 (verified via GitHub API), runnable locally; the cloud console carries filing number Shanghai-TongYiWanXiang-202410090024.

entries.summaryZh: 按任务分 11 大类，归三族：找现成的（编程 / 对话 / 图像 / 视频 / 音频 / 研究 / 安全与评测）、自己搭（自动化 / 框架）、接上与跑起来（MCP 工具 / 本地运行器）。各族坐标系不同，不做横向排名。
entries.summaryEn: Eleven categories grouped into three families by task: ready-made (coding / chat / image / video / audio / research / safety & evaluation), build-your-own (automation / frameworks), and plug-in-and-run (MCP tools / local runners). The families use different coordinate systems, so this site does not rank across them.

entries.summaryZh: 1Password 官方 Environments MCP server（本地 stdio，随桌面应用）：凭据类 MCP 的安全边界判例—— agent 能建环境、列变量名、加变量、挂本机 .env，但 by design 密钥值永不回传给 agent； 敏感操作按 Environment 粒度弹桌面授权窗，企业可策略级开关。beta 阶段； 配套插件仓（Claude/Codex/Kiro）活跃（推送 2026-10-29）。 与社区「读 secret 值」那批 1Password MCP 是本质不同的两回事。
entries.summaryEn: 1Password official Environments MCP server (local stdio, rides the desktop app): the security-boundary precedent for credential-class MCPs — the agent can create environments, list variable names, add variables, mount local .env files, but by design secret values are never returned to the agent; sensitive operations po

entries.summaryZh: Atlassian 官方 Remote MCP server：一个端点接 Jira+Confluence 两面——agent 搜需求、 建 issue、写 wiki。OAuth 3LO 用户鉴权，可见面跟着账号权限走。
entries.summaryEn: Atlassian's official Remote MCP server: one endpoint covers Jira + Confluence — agents search requirements, create issues, write wiki pages. OAuth 3LO user auth; visibility follows account permissions.

entries.summaryZh: Brave 官方搜索 MCP server（MIT）：给 agent 补一路独立检索源（web/新闻/图像/地点）。 一条归档事实：MCP 组织仓里的旧 Brave reference 已归档，官方 README 明写由 @brave 包接替—— 本条目就是现役那条。
entries.summaryEn: Brave's official search MCP server (MIT): an independent retrieval source for agents (web/news/images/places). One archival fact: the old Brave reference in the MCP org repo was archived, and the official README says the @brave package replaces it — this profile is the live one.

entries.summaryZh: Browserbase 官方 MCP server：云端浏览器 + Stagehand 自然语言网页驱动，6 工具 （start/end/navigate/act/observe/extract）。本档案的核心两口径：GitHub 自托管仓已 archived （README 顶部明写「仅存档、不代表现役实现」）——现役是托管线 mcp.browserbase.com/mcp， 产品本身活跃（docs 在册、npm 3.0.0、底座 Stagehand 25,883★ 推送 2026-10-30）。 自托管线只是「server 进程在你机器上」，浏览器会话仍在 Browserbase 云端、API key 照要。
entries.summaryEn: Browserbase official MCP server: cloud browser + Stagehand natural-language page driving, 6 tools (start/end/navigate/act/observe/extract). The core two-wording of this dossier: the GitHub self-hosted repo is archived (the README top states plainly it is archival-only, not representative of the current implementation)

entries.summaryZh: Chrome 官方团队做的「让 agent 看见浏览器」：CDP 直连，导航、交互、截图、performance trace、 网络与 console 全暴露给编码 agent。Apache-2.0、53k★、活跃维护。 安全口径一句话：它驱动真实浏览器=真实网络出口，server 本身没有 URL 白名单层。
entries.summaryEn: Chrome's own team built 'let the agent see the browser': direct CDP — navigate, interact, screenshot, performance traces, network and console. Apache-2.0, 53k stars, active. Security in one line: it drives a real browser with a real network exit, and the server itself has no URL allowlist layer.

entries.summaryZh: Cloudflare 官方 MCP server（Apache-2.0）：agent 写 Worker、部署、管 D1/R2/DNS、查官方 docs。 提供受限 token——但记住「能部署=能跑任意代码」，token 要按最小面配。
entries.summaryEn: Cloudflare's official MCP server (Apache-2.0): agents write Workers, deploy, manage D1/R2/DNS, search official docs. It has the finest restricted-token granularity in its class — but remember 'can deploy = can run arbitrary code'; scope tokens to the minimum.

entries.summaryZh: 远程托管的文档服务 —— 为 Agent 提供版本感知的库文档，MIT 开源但核心服务在 Upstash 侧。
entries.summaryEn: A remotely hosted documentation service — version-aware library documentation for agents; MIT-licensed, but the core service lives on Upstash's side.

entries.summaryZh: Datadog 自营的官方 MCP server（mcp.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp）：agent 排障时直查生产日志、 指标、trace、incident。三条硬口径：凭据透传——RBAC 原样生效，server 不越权； 工具按 toolsets 分组按需开；GovCloud 不兼容（官方明写）。 诚实标注：无开源仓；另有一条独立的本地 Code Security MCP Server，别混。
entries.summaryEn: Datadog's self-run official MCP server (mcp.datadoghq.com/v1/mcp): agents query live production logs, metrics, traces and incidents while debugging. Three hard facts: credentials are passed through — RBAC applies as-is, the server cannot exceed the user; tools are grouped into toolsets, enable on demand; GovCloud is no

entries.summaryZh: 不是可用工具——官方明说这是给 MCP 客户端开发者做功能测试的 server，唯一用途是验证客户端协议实现是否正确。
entries.summaryEn: Not a usable tool — the official page states plainly that this server exists for MCP client developers to run functional tests against; its only purpose is verifying that a client implements the protocol correctly.

entries.summaryZh: Exa 官方 MCP server（MIT）：默认就两工具——web_search_exa 搜索、web_fetch_exa 读正文， 干净 markdown 直供 agent。匿名就能连（限流），OAuth/API key 提额并解锁 Exa Agent 多步研究。 诚实标注：GitHub releases 为空，发版线在 npm；advanced search 与 agent_run 要 ?tools= 显式开。
entries.summaryEn: Exa's official MCP server (MIT): two default tools — web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa, clean markdown straight to the agent. Anonymous access works (rate-limited); OAuth/API key raises limits and unlocks the multi-step Exa Agent. Honest note: GitHub releases is empty, the release line is npm; advanced search and agent_

entries.summaryZh: 把网页内容转成 Markdown 的 reference server，官方在其 README 里明确标注了安全警告：它能访问本地与内网 IP。
entries.summaryEn: A reference server that converts web pages to Markdown, with an explicit security warning in its official README: it can reach local and internal IPs.

entries.summaryZh: Figma 官方 MCP server：把设计系统上下文（组件/变量/Code Connect）喂给编码 agent， 还能写画布。三条硬口径：远程 server 是官方推荐形态；只有 MCP catalog 里的客户端能连； beta 免费是暂时的，将来转用量计费。
entries.summaryEn: Figma's official MCP server: design-system context (components/variables/Code Connect) fed to coding agents, plus canvas writes. Three hard facts: the remote server is the officially recommended form; only clients in the Figma MCP catalog can connect; beta-free is temporary — usage-based pricing is coming.

entries.summaryZh: MCP 官方 reference server 里的文件操作实现。它是「白名单目录」式访问：必须显式声明允许目录，不允许静默访问全盘。
entries.summaryEn: The file-operation implementation among MCP's official reference servers, requiring allowed directories to be declared explicitly, with no silent whole-disk access.

entries.summaryZh: Firecrawl 官方 MCP server（MIT）：web 上下文全家桶——搜索、抓正文、解析 PDF、 站点级 crawl/map、真实浏览器 interact、页面 monitor。三条硬口径：keyless 免费档只有 3 工具； 发版线在 npm 不在 GitHub releases；API key 绝不进 URL 也不进 agent 聊天（官方 README 明令）。 仓已从 mendableai/ 迁到 firecrawl/ org（301 坐实）。
entries.summaryEn: Firecrawl's official MCP server (MIT): the full web-context kit — search, scrape, PDF parsing, site-level crawl/map, real-browser interact, page monitoring. Three hard facts: the keyless free tier exposes only 3 tools; the release line is npm, not GitHub releases; the API key must never go into the server URL or the ag

entries.summaryZh: MCP 官方 reference server 里的版本控制实现。它作用域限定在指定 git 仓库，但具备完整的本地写操作能力。
entries.summaryEn: The version-control implementation among MCP's official reference servers, scoped to a given git repository but with full local write capability.

entries.summaryZh: GitHub 官方自己的 MCP server（仓库自述 "GitHub's official MCP Server"）， 它有本地 Docker 与远程托管两种形态。它把 GitHub 平台能力暴露给任意 MCP 客户端。
entries.summaryEn: GitHub's official MCP server (repository description: "GitHub's official MCP Server"). It connects any MCP client to GitHub's platform: reading repositories and code files, managing issues and PRs, monitoring Actions, inspecting code-scanning / Dependabot findings, and reading notifications. Two forms. The remote hoste

entries.summaryZh: Grafana 官方 MCP server（Apache-2.0，Go 实现）：把 agent 接进你的 Grafana 实例—— 仪表盘、数据源、统一 SQL、告警与 IRM。三条硬口径：服务账号 token + RBAC scopes 是前置门； 部分工具组默认禁用；整份仪表盘 JSON 是上下文窗口黑洞，官方备了 summary/JSONPath/patch 三件套。
entries.summaryEn: Grafana's official MCP server (Apache-2.0, Go): plugs agents into your Grafana instance — dashboards, datasources, unified SQL, alerts and IRM. Three hard facts: a service-account token + RBAC scopes are the front gate; some tool groups are disabled by default; full dashboard JSON is a context-window black hole, and th

entries.en: A map of academic research tools
entries.summaryZh: 按「找论文 / 读论文 / 查引用态度 / 做综述」四件事分组，给出 Semantic Scholar、Scite、SciSpace 等工具的边界与官方入口。
entries.summaryEn: Grouped by four jobs — find papers, read papers, check citation stance, build a review — with the boundaries and official links for Semantic Scholar, Scite, SciSpace and others.

entries.summaryZh: 会话内的状态、跨会话的持久事实、外部记忆库——三层记忆各自解决什么问题，以及共同的坑。
entries.summaryEn: In-session state, cross-session facts, and external stores — what each memory layer solves, and the pitfalls they share.

entries.summaryZh: 四条轴决定：成本结构、数据与合规、延迟与吞吐、模型能力与更新；用一张决策表缩小到一条路线。
entries.summaryEn: Four axes decide it — cost structure, data and compliance, latency and throughput, model capability and updates. A decision table narrows it to one route.

entries.summaryZh: 十条版本、入口与迁移记录，分别标注事件日、待核日期和计划停用；说明对原有选择的影响，不以链接可达冒充功能核验。
entries.summaryEn: Ten version, entry-point and migration records, distinguishing event dates, unconfirmed dates and planned shutdowns, with implications for earlier choices.

entries.en: How to choose a chat assistant
entries.summaryZh: 不排名、不报价格：先定中文、数据、价格、生态四个约束，再按场景缩小到 2–3 个候选。
entries.summaryEn: No rankings and no prices: fix four constraints — Chinese, data, price, ecosystem — then narrow to 2–3 candidates by scenario.

entries.zh: 采购与权限审计清单：问厂商的 18 个问题
entries.summaryZh: 一份可直接发给厂商的采购问卷，覆盖身份、数据、日志、模型、合同与退出六组；附权限矩阵模板与 6 项季度审计，问题都对应官方文档可查项。
entries.summaryEn: A vendor questionnaire you can send as-is, covering identity, data, logs, model, contract and exit in six groups, with a permission-matrix template and six quarterly audit items, each answerable from official docs.

entries.zh: 国内可用性怎么读：直连、主体与备案的口径
entries.summaryZh: 用 tools 档案里的 cn 三个字段回答「国内能不能连、谁在运营、有没有备案」；给出 225 份档案的统计口径、限制与自查方法，不做实时可用性承诺。
entries.summaryEn: Three cn fields in the tool dossiers answer whether a product connects from the mainland, who operates it and whether it is filed; this page gives the counting rules, limits and a self-check method for 225 dossiers, with no real-time guarantee.

entries.zh: Agent 框架：LangGraph / OpenAI Agents SDK / Google ADK / Claude Agent SDK 怎么选
entries.summaryZh: 按流程控制、会话状态、工具执行与部署边界对照四个 SDK；区分框架提供的机制与应用仍需配置的部分。
entries.summaryEn: Compare workflow control, session state, tool execution and deployment boundaries; distinguish SDK mechanisms from application configuration.

entries.zh: 浏览器 Agent 三选一：Playwright MCP / Browserbase MCP / Chrome DevTools MCP
entries.summaryZh: 三个浏览器 MCP 的适用条件、能力边界与价格档位；按「本地还是云端、要不要模型、要不要性能分析」给出一句选择，并写明什么情况下换另一个。
entries.summaryEn: Applicability, capability limits and plan tiers for three browser MCP servers; a one-line choice based on local vs cloud, whether a model is needed and whether performance analysis is required, plus when to switch.

entries.zh: 聊天助手：ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude / Copilot 怎么选
entries.en: Chat assistants: ChatGPT vs Gemini vs Claude vs Copilot
entries.summaryZh: 按数据条款、研究线、生态绑定与大陆可达四项硬约束筛选，再按场景落到一个主助手加一个备选。
entries.summaryEn: Filter by data terms, research line, ecosystem lock-in and mainland reachability, then pick one primary assistant and one backup by scenario.

entries.zh: 写代码：终端 / IDE / 云端 Agent 怎么选
entries.en: Coding agents: terminal vs IDE vs cloud
entries.summaryZh: 先定执行面（终端 / IDE / 云端），再比权限模型、后台续跑与仓库上下文；给每个候选写明适用条件与一句「什么情况下选另一个」。
entries.summaryEn: Fix the execution surface first (terminal, IDE, cloud), then compare permission models, background continuation and repo context; each candidate gets its conditions and one line on when to pick another.

entries.zh: 本地跑模型：Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp / vLLM 怎么选
entries.en: Local runners: Ollama vs LM Studio vs llama.cpp vs vLLM
entries.summaryZh: 按硬件、量化格式、并发与服务化四面选 runtime；桌面图形、单机脚本、生产服务是三条不同路线。
entries.summaryEn: Choose by hardware, quantization format, concurrency and serving needs; desktop GUI, single-machine scripting and production serving are three different routes.

entries.zh: 图像与视频：一条内容该用哪条工具链
entries.summaryZh: 先分图像与视频两条链，再按输入模态、权利条款与工作流位置选；每个候选写明适用条件与替代路线。
entries.summaryEn: Split image and video into two chains, then choose by input modality, rights terms and workflow position; each candidate gets its conditions and an alternative.

entries.zh: 研究工具：Perplexity / Kagi / NotebookLM / Elicit 怎么选
entries.summaryZh: 按检索深度、来源透明度、资料锚定与引用管理四面选；搜索引擎、资料集问答与文献抽取是三件事。
entries.summaryEn: Choose by search depth, source transparency, source grounding and citation management; search engines, source-set Q&A and literature extraction are three different jobs.

entries.zh: 成本算式：云端、Agent、本地与视频四条线
entries.en: Cost formulas: cloud, agents, local and video
entries.summaryZh: 不给价格数字，只给四条可复算的算式与口径：token、席位、显存电费、视频秒数；每条附官方定价页指针。
entries.summaryEn: No price figures, only four reproducible formulas and conventions — tokens, seats, local power, video seconds — each with an official pricing pointer.
entries.keywords: 多少钱 费用 成本 价格 token API 预算 cost price budget tokens calculate

entries.summaryZh: 钱花在哪、怎么省：token 记账、前缀缓存、上下文膨胀与步数上限——只讲机制，不报价格。
entries.summaryEn: Where the money goes and how to curb it: token accounting, prefix caching, context bloat, and step caps — mechanisms only, no prices.

entries.summaryZh: 先定义任务和成功条件，再用固定样本检查改动、记录实际失败；评测器的判断也需要核对。
entries.summaryEn: No evaluation, no iteration — offline regression testing, live monitoring, and the pitfalls of evaluators themselves.

entries.zh: 练习包 · Builder：用 10 篇站内文档搭一个带引用的问答
entries.en: Exercise: cited answers from 10 source pages
entries.summaryZh: 一个可独立完成的 RAG 练习：选 10 篇站内页面做语料，产出 10 题答案、引用表、评测表与失败记录；附评分标准与参考答案结构。
entries.summaryEn: A self-contained RAG exercise: use 10 site pages as a corpus and produce 10 answers, a citation table, an evaluation sheet and a failure log, with a rubric and a model-answer outline.

entries.zh: 练习包 · Creator：把一份官方资料做成三件套并留下事实表
entries.en: Exercise: three assets from one official source
entries.summaryZh: 选一份官方产品页，产出短文、图像提示词与 30 秒口播稿，并附 5 条事实核对表与 2 条被拒的说法；评分标准看引用、边界与一致性。
entries.summaryEn: Take one official product page and produce a short post, an image prompt and a 30-second script, plus a five-claim fact table and two rejected claims; the rubric checks citations, boundaries and consistency.

entries.zh: 练习包 · Manager：写一页供应商决策备忘录
entries.en: Exercise: a one-page vendor decision memo
entries.summaryZh: 用三个成本维度对比「调 API」与「自己部署」，交一页决策备忘录、评分表、5 个尽职调查问题与退出计划；评分标准看口径、可复核与退出路径。
entries.summaryEn: Compare API usage with self-hosting on three cost dimensions and deliver a one-page decision memo, a score sheet, five due-diligence questions and an exit plan; the rubric checks conventions, reproducibility and exit paths.

entries.zh: 失败库：按症状排查与十类资料误读
entries.summaryZh: 从鉴权、限流、容量、延迟、工具参数、JSON、检索与文件问题开始排查；另附十类资料误读、证据与记录模板。
entries.summaryEn: Diagnose authentication, rate limits, memory, latency, tool inputs, JSON, retrieval and file issues, with ten evidence misreads and a troubleshooting record.
entries.keywords: 报错 排错 调不通 失败 鉴权 429 401 慢 troubleshooting error authentication rate limit

entries.summaryZh: 输入输出与工具三层防线、触发即止的 tripwire 机制，以及并行与阻塞的成本取舍。
entries.summaryEn: Input, output, and tool-level defenses, tripwires that halt on trigger, and the cost trade-off between parallel and blocking checks.

entries.zh: 怎么搭一条最小评测流程
entries.en: How to build a minimal evaluation pipeline
entries.summaryZh: 五个部件——样本集、跑批、判据、记录、对比——半天能跑通一条，够用再扩，不先建平台。
entries.summaryEn: Five parts — sample set, batch run, graders, records and comparison — enough for one afternoon, extend only when it pays off.

entries.summaryZh: 把合规拆成可计量的工作项：差距分析、证据生产、复核轮次、维护周期，用你自己的口径填单价。
entries.summaryEn: Break compliance into countable work items — gap analysis, evidence production, review rounds and upkeep cycles — then apply your own unit rates.

entries.zh: 怎么做一次数据流梳理
entries.en: How to map a data flow
entries.summaryZh: 一次梳理要画出字段从哪来、经谁处理、存到哪里、多久删；把「数据不出域」这类说法落成可核对的图与表。
entries.summaryEn: One pass should show where each field originates, who processes it, where it is stored and when it is deleted — turning "data stays in our domain" into a checkable diagram and table.

entries.zh: 怎么给 agent 选护栏
entries.en: How to pick guardrails for an agent
entries.summaryZh: 按输入、输出、工具、对话策略四个位置分工，用误拦数与漏拦数决定检查装在哪一层、查什么。
entries.summaryEn: Split checks across input, output, tool and dialog-policy layers, then use false-block and miss counts to decide where each check belongs and what it inspects.

entries.en: How to prepare a red-team session
entries.summaryZh: 先定范围、名单与记录格式，再让一组人分头试攻，把发现变成可测量的风险项，别把一次演练读成安全证明。
entries.summaryEn: Fix scope, harm list and record format first, let a team probe separately, then turn findings into measurable risk items instead of reading one session as proof of safety.

entries.zh: 怎么读一份第三方安全报告
entries.en: How to read a third-party safety report
entries.summaryZh: 按评估对象、版本、任务口径、结论边界四件事读别人出的安全报告，把「通过了」还原成「在什么条件下通过了什么」。
entries.summaryEn: Read external safety reports along subject, version, task definition and claim boundary, turning "it passed" into "what passed, under which conditions".

entries.zh: 怎么审 AI 供应商问卷
entries.en: How to vet an AI vendor questionnaire
entries.summaryZh: 问卷的答案要能被文档指认：六组问题、三档判定、例外写进合同附录，口头承诺一律按未知记。
entries.summaryEn: Every answer must be pointable to a document: six question groups, a three-way verdict, exceptions moved into the contract annex. Verbal promises count as unknown.

entries.en: How to wire evaluations into release
entries.summaryZh: 评测跑通不等于会挡住坏版本；本篇写卡点位置、失败判定、放行例外与回滚，让分数进入发布决策。
entries.summaryEn: A passing pipeline does not by itself stop a bad release. This guide covers where to gate, how to fail, which exceptions get signed off, and how to roll back.

entries.zh: 图像 / 视频 / 音频工具怎么选
entries.en: How to choose image, video and audio tools
entries.summaryZh: 商用许可先过筛，再看输入输出与编辑链、本地还是云端、中文与区域可用；最后按产量估算成本。
entries.summaryEn: Screen for commercial licensing first, then input/output and edit chains, local vs cloud, Chinese and regional access; finally estimate cost by volume.

entries.summaryZh: 多个 agent 怎么分工、怎么交接、怎么收拢结果，以及什么时候根本不该上多 agent。
entries.summaryEn: How multiple agents divide work, hand off, and merge results — and when not to go multi-agent at all.

entries.summaryZh: 先想清楚步骤再动手，还是边做边定——规划模式怎么选，以及规划为什么会失效、失效了怎么救。
entries.summaryEn: Plan first or decide as you go — how to choose a planning pattern, and why plans fail.

entries.zh: 任务：做一条 60 秒产品视频
entries.summaryZh: 脚本、分镜、生成、剪辑、权利登记五段；含单段时长限制、成本算式、失败模式与交付清单。
entries.summaryEn: Five stages — script, storyboard, generation, editing and rights logging — with per-clip limits, a cost formula, failure modes and a delivery checklist.
entries.keywords: 短片 视频 分镜 剪辑 video storyboard editing

entries.zh: 任务：审阅长文与版本变化，保留原文位置
entries.en: Playbook: review document changes with evidence
entries.summaryZh: 用两版虚构制度练习单位变化、否定条件和内部冲突；先给审阅问题，不把模型改写当已批准的新规则。
entries.summaryEn: Use two fictional policy versions to check unit changes, negated conditions and internal conflicts; deliver located questions rather than an assumed approved rewrite.
entries.keywords: 审阅长文 文档对比 合同修改 版本差异 review long document compare draft version

entries.zh: 任务：用编码 Agent 修一个真实 bug
entries.en: Playbook: fixing a real bug with a coding agent
entries.summaryZh: 从仓库上下文、复现、计划、改动、测试到审查的六步流程；含权限设置、成本算式、失败模式与验收单。
entries.summaryEn: A six-step flow from repo context and reproduction through planning, editing and testing to review, with permission settings, a cost formula, failure modes and an acceptance list.
entries.keywords: 修代码 修复错误 调试 bug fix coding debugging

entries.zh: 任务：在自己的机器上跑一个模型
entries.en: Playbook: running a model on your own machine
entries.summaryZh: 显存、量化档、runtime、评估、监控五步；含体积算式、量化索引、失败模式与验收单。
entries.summaryEn: Five steps — VRAM, quantization tier, runtime, evaluation, monitoring — with a size formula, the quantization index, failure modes and an acceptance list.
entries.keywords: 本地模型 怎么安装 离线运行 local model offline setup install

entries.zh: 任务：把会议录音整理成可确认的纪要与行动项
entries.en: Playbook: meeting audio to notes and actions
entries.summaryZh: 用合成录音练习姓名、否定、日期、决定与提议的区分；保留回听位置，未确认的负责人和期限留空。
entries.summaryEn: Use synthetic audio to check names, negation, dates, decisions and proposals; preserve replay locations and leave unassigned owners/deadlines unresolved.
entries.keywords: 录音转文字 会议纪要 会议记录 待办 行动项 audio meeting transcript minutes action items

entries.zh: 任务：把 PDF 或扫描页转成可核对的表格
entries.en: Playbook: turn a PDF or scan into a checkable table
entries.summaryZh: 先分辨文字层与图像，再保留页码和行号；用空单元格、前导零和金额校验练习，不把参考答案当 OCR 实测。
entries.summaryEn: Distinguish text from image input, retain page and row evidence, and check blanks, leading zeros and amounts. Includes designed references, not OCR results.
entries.keywords: 扫描件 转表格 发票 PDF OCR table scan scanned invoice extract spreadsheet

entries.zh: 任务：做一份可核查的研究简报
entries.en: Playbook: producing a checkable research brief
entries.summaryZh: 问题、检索、来源、综合、复核五步；每个结论挂来源与日期，含工具分工、失败模式与验收单。
entries.summaryEn: Five steps — question, search, sources, synthesis, review — with a source and date on every claim, plus tool roles, failure modes and an acceptance list.
entries.keywords: 查资料 研究简报 文献 来源 research brief evidence sources

entries.zh: 任务：搭一个客服 Agent 并上线
entries.en: Playbook: building and shipping a customer-service agent
entries.summaryZh: 意图、知识库、工具、护栏、评估、上线六段；含生态锁定、许可、人工兜底、验收单与失败模式。
entries.summaryEn: Six stages — intents, knowledge base, tools, guardrails, evaluation, launch — with ecosystem lock-in, licensing, human fallback, an acceptance list and failure modes.

entries.zh: 任务：合并多张表，留下冲突与异常
entries.en: Playbook: merge tables while preserving conflicts
entries.summaryZh: 用订单与客户三张表练习文本主键、重复、冲突、日期歧义与未匹配项；交付干净表、异常表和可复算口径。
entries.summaryEn: Practice text keys, duplicates, conflicting amounts, ambiguous dates and unmatched records; deliver clean data, exceptions and reproducible checks.
entries.keywords: 合并表格 数据清洗 去重 对账 Excel CSV join merge clean duplicate conflict

entries.zh: 团队 90 天落地 playbook：从试点到权限收口
entries.summaryZh: 把团队引入 AI 拆成 0–30、31–60、61–90 三段，每段给目标、动作、验收点与负责人；权限矩阵与审计项按厂商官方 admin 文档落地，不写空泛口号。
entries.summaryEn: A 0–30, 31–60, 61–90 rollout with goals, actions, acceptance points and owners per phase; the permission matrix and audit items follow vendor admin documentation rather than slogans.

entries.zh: 20 题自测：AI 基础、评测与选型
entries.summaryZh: 20 道基础概念、评测与选型简答题，附参考要点与复习入口；分数仅用于本练习，不证明部署或带教能力。
entries.summaryEn: Twenty questions on fundamentals, evaluation and selection, with answer points and review links. Exercise scores do not establish deployment or teaching competence.

entries.zh: 工具箱：Agent 评估、护栏、客服验收、故障清单
entries.summaryZh: 四个可直接复制的文本块：评估 rubric、四层护栏清单、客服验收单、故障复盘清单。
entries.summaryEn: Four copyable text blocks: an evaluation rubric, a four-layer guardrail checklist, a service acceptance sheet and an incident review checklist.

entries.zh: 工具箱：提示词、上下文预算、RAG 清单、选型表
entries.summaryZh: 四个可直接复制的文本块：提示词结构、上下文预算表、RAG 分块与重排清单、模型选型工作表。
entries.summaryEn: Four copyable text blocks: a prompt structure, a context budget table, a RAG chunking/reranking checklist and a model selection worksheet.

entries.zh: 工具箱：权限矩阵、许可清单、视频权利表、成本算式
entries.summaryZh: 四个可直接复制的文本块：Agent 权限矩阵、模型许可检查表、视频版权登记表、成本算式模板。
entries.summaryEn: Four copyable text blocks: an agent permission matrix, a model licence checklist, a video rights log and a cost formula template.

entries.zh: 工具箱：四张工作表（立项、发布、迁移、泄露）
entries.summaryZh: 四个可直接复制的检查表：项目立项、内容发布前、模型迁移评估、数据泄露路径排查。
entries.summaryEn: Four copyable checklists: project kickoff, pre-publish, model migration assessment and data-leak path review.

entries.summaryZh: MCP server 的权限范围、传输方式与输出可用性。收录标准：已发布为可安装的 MCP server、有官方仓库或文档可回溯、近 30 天有实质更新。这里是能力缺口查表，不是选型对比。
entries.summaryEn: The permission scope, transport and output usability of MCP servers. Admission criteria: released as an installable MCP server, has an official repository or documentation that can be traced back, and has substantive updates within the last 30 days. This is a capability-gap reference table, not a selection comparison.

entries.summaryZh: Intercom 官方托管 MCP server（闭源 remote，streamable-http）：客服数据接进 AI 工具—— 14 工具：query-DSL search/fetch + conversations/contacts/companies 读 + Help Center articles 读写 + Fin Operator 五工具（apply_proposals 会真改线上配置；Bearer 连接拿不到 Operator 工具，要 OAuth）。 区域两口径：US/EU 端点分开（EU 数据在 EU 内处理）、AU 工作区不支持； 旧 SSE 端点已 deprecated。GitHub 那个仓只是文档仓，别当源
entries.summaryEn: Intercom official hosted MCP server (closed-source remote, streamable-http): customer-support data plugged into AI tools — 14 tools: query-DSL search/fetch + reading conversations/contacts/companies + reading and writing Help Center articles + the five Fin Operator tools (apply_proposals really changes live workspace c

entries.summaryZh: Linear 官方 MCP server（mcp.linear.app/mcp）：agent 搜 issue、建 issue、改状态。 一条直抓事实：旧 SSE 端点已下线——配置里还写 /sse 的要先换 /mcp。
entries.summaryEn: Linear's official MCP server (mcp.linear.app/mcp): agents search, create and update issues. One direct-fetched fact: the old SSE endpoint is gone — configs still pointing at /sse need to switch to /mcp.

entries.summaryZh: 用本地知识图谱做跨会话持久记忆的 reference server。它记忆落盘、跨会话共享，但没有访问控制。
entries.summaryEn: A reference server implementing cross-session persistent memory with a local knowledge graph — memory is written to disk, shared across sessions, with no access control.

entries.summaryZh: MongoDB 官方 MCP server（mongodb-js 仓，Apache-2.0）：agent 连库查集合、跑聚合、 写数据、管 Atlas。诚实标注：docs/mcp 路径 404——现役官方线在 GitHub 仓。 安全口径：删除类工具带确认参数，但确认不是沙箱——凭据才是边界。
entries.summaryEn: MongoDB's official MCP server (mongodb-js repo, Apache-2.0): agents connect to databases, query collections, run aggregations, write data, manage Atlas. Honest note: the docs/mcp path 404s — the live official line is the GitHub repo. Delete tools carry confirmation parameters, but confirmation is not a sandbox — creden

entries.summaryZh: Neon 官方 MCP server（MIT）：agent 管 Neon 项目、建分支、跑 SQL。 特色是分支模型——agent 可以在库副本上试改动；但默认连接面照旧， 按「它能执行 SQL、管理 key 能删项目」设防。诚实标注：旧 docs 路径 404，现役以仓为准。
entries.summaryEn: Neon's official MCP server (MIT): agents manage Neon projects, create branches, run SQL. The signature is the branch model — agents can try changes on a copy; but the default connection surface is unchanged, so defend as if it can execute SQL and the management key can delete projects.

entries.summaryZh: Notion 官方自己的 MCP server：纯远程托管（mcp.notion.com/mcp），agent 能搜工作区、 读写页面与数据库。要点一句话：agent 的可见面 = 你连的那个账号的页面权限。
entries.summaryEn: Notion's own MCP server: fully hosted (mcp.notion.com/mcp) — agents search the workspace and read/write pages and databases. One line matters: the agent's visibility equals the page permissions of the account you connect.

entries.summaryZh: 微软维护的浏览器自动化 server。它用无障碍树而非截图驱动，不需要视觉模型。输出是结构化快照。
entries.summaryEn: A browser automation server maintained by Microsoft, driven by the accessibility tree rather than screenshots — no vision model needed, and the output is a structured snapshot.

entries.summaryZh: Sentry 官方的 agent 工具线：把「查崩溃、看事件、对 release」包成 MCP 工具， 编码 agent 能直接问「这个报错线上有没有」。诚实标注：旧仓 sentry-mcp 已 redirect 到 getsentry/toolkit； 许可是 FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0——不是纯 Apache，生产用途有限制期。
entries.summaryEn: Sentry's official agent tooling line: crashes, events and releases wrapped as MCP tools, so a coding agent can ask 'is this error live?'. Honest notes: the old sentry-mcp repo now redirects to getsentry/toolkit; the license is FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 — not plain Apache, production use has a restriction window.

entries.summaryZh: 提供单个 sequential_thinking 工具，让 Agent 以可修订、可分支的方式逐步推进复杂问题——它不产生智能，只产生结构。
entries.summaryEn: Provides a single sequential_thinking tool that lets an agent work through a complex problem in a revisable, branchable way — it produces no intelligence, only structure.

entries.summaryZh: Shopify 官方 Dev MCP server（npm ISC，本地 stdio，无鉴权）：给编码 agent 补 Shopify 平台上下文—— 文档检索（search_dev_docs/fetch_docs_by_path）+ Admin GraphQL schema 探查（introspect_admin_schema）。 它是 Shopify AI Toolkit 三形态之一（插件 / agent skills / Dev MCP）； GitHub 无独立 dev-mcp 仓（代码随 npm 发布），inventory 旧 URL agents-of-change 已 404。 纯读面、不碰店铺数据——店铺操作走 Sho
entries.summaryEn: Shopify official Dev MCP server (npm ISC, local stdio, no auth): gives your coding agent Shopify platform context — doc retrieval (search_dev_docs/fetch_docs_by_path) + Admin GraphQL schema probing (introspect_admin_schema).
